AI.conclusion: 非共线磁序可在真实空间的不同亚格子上同时实现ALM与CFIM双重自旋分裂机制，并可通过铁电极化实现自旋极化与非线性/注入电流的磁电调控。

title: Localization induced by Sinai disorder in mass-exchange models
summary: We introduce a conservative continuous-mass-exchange model with quenched disorder in the splitting laws on the bonds of a finite segment. Although the dynamics is generically irreversible, its stationary mean mass profile remarkably turns out to be exactly solvable through an associated birth-and-death chain and has a Gibbs representation in terms of a simple random-walk potential. If $N$ is the number of bonds and $β$ measures the strength of disorder, the parameter $β\sqrt N$ separates an asymptotically flat profile, a Brownian crossover, and a profile localized near the global minimum. We characterize the fluctuations of macroscopic masses and identify arcsine laws for the localization centre, the competition between left and right valleys, and the disorder-averaged mass measure. Furthermore, for the extremal masses, we discuss the emergent limiting random variable in terms of the literature linking finite RW paths seen from its minimum to infinite-horizon walks conditioned to stay positive. Finally, in proximity of the localization transition point $β=0$, we show that the inverse participation ratio for the extremal masses give rises to a scaling with decay of order $k^{-3/2}$ consistent with the scaling limit of the latter conditioned walk. In the same limit, the inverse participation ratio shows a scaling form.

AI.tldr: 该论文引入有限段上键劈裂律含淬火无序的守恒连续质量交换模型，证明其不可逆动力学的平稳平均质量分布可通过关联的生灭链精确求解并具有基于随机游走势的Gibbs表示；以β√N为参数刻画平坦、Brownian交叉与局部化三相，并给出宏观质量涨落、反正弦律、极值质量与局域化转变附近的IPR标度。
AI.motivation: 守恒质量交换模型通常难以得到平稳分布的解析解，尤其当键上的转移/劈裂律带有淬火无序时，动力学一般不可逆。作者希望找到一个尽管不可逆、但平稳平均质量分布仍可精确求解、并具有清晰统计物理结构（Gibbs形式、随机游走势）的模型，从而系统研究无序强度与系统尺度竞争下的局域化现象。
AI.method: 构建有限段键上的连续质量交换模型，劈裂律带淬火无序；将平稳平均质量分布映射为关联的生灭链，并用简单随机游走势给出Gibbs表示。以N为键数、β为无序强度，通过β√N区分不同标度区。进一步分析宏观质量涨落，导出局域化中心、左右谷竞争及无序平均质量测度的反正弦律；对极值质量，借助有限随机游走路径自其最小值出发与条件正无穷时域游走的联系讨论极限随机变量；在β=0附近计算极值质量的逆参与比（IPR）及其标度形式。
AI.result: 平稳平均质量分布获得精确解并有Gibbs表示；β√N区分出渐近平坦分布、Brownian交叉和集中于全局最小值的局域化分布三种情形。得到宏观质量涨落特征及若干反正弦律；极值质量的极限随机变量与条件正随机游走的文献结果相连；在局域化转变点β=0附近，极值质量的IPR按k^{-3/2}衰减标度，且IPR呈现标度形式，与相应条件游走的标度极限一致。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提供了一个不可逆守恒无序输运中平稳分布仍可精确求解的范例，并用随机游走势统一描述平坦—交叉—局域化相变、质量涨落反正弦律及局域化转变处的临界标度行为，将有限随机游走最小值视角与条件正无穷游走及IPR临界指数联系起来。

title: Synchronization induced by stochastic subsystem resetting in complex networks
summary: We study synchronization in network-coupled oscillators subject to stochastic resetting of a subset of nodes. We show that resetting can induce collective coherence in oscillators that are never directly reset, through the interplay of network structure, frequency heterogeneity, and the organization of the reset subsystem. In the infinite-resetting-rate limit, the reset nodes become effectively pinned to a reference phase, and linearization near synchronization maps the dynamics of the remaining subsystem onto a grounded-Laplacian problem. This formulation yields an analytical relation between the synchronization level and the reset parameters, providing an estimate of the coupling strength required to achieve a prescribed degree of coherence. Beyond the linear regime, we develop a mean-field description in which the reset subsystem acts as an effective ordering field for the remaining oscillators. Numerical simulations across different network topologies confirm these predictions and show that synchronization is enhanced by increasing both the reset fraction and network connectivity. In heterogeneous networks, the placement of reset nodes can strongly influence the synchronization response. For frequency distributions with nonzero mean, resetting competes with the intrinsic collective rotation and can drive the system from a rotating synchronized state to a phase-locked state. These results establish subsystem resetting as a mechanism for inducing and controlling collective synchronization in complex networks.

AI.tldr: 研究网络中部分节点的随机重置(resetting)如何诱导整体同步，发现重置可通过网络结构、频率异质性与重置子系统的组织方式使未被重置的节点也产生集体相干，并用接地拉普拉斯(grounded-Laplacian)框架给出解析关系。
AI.motivation: 探究局部随机重置这一非平衡机制能否在耦合振子网络中诱导并控制集体同步，尤其是未被直接重置的节点如何受其影响，以及重置参数、网络拓扑与频率分布的作用。
AI.method: 在无限重置速率极限下，重置节点被"钉"在参考相位，剩余子系统的线性化动力学映射为接地拉普拉斯问题，得到同步度与重置参数的解析关系及所需耦合强度估计；超出线性区时建立平均场描述，把重置子系统视为对其余振子的有效有序场；并在多种网络拓扑上做数值模拟验证。
AI.result: 解析预测与数值模拟一致；提高重置比例和网络连通性可增强同步；在异质网络中重置节点的放置显著影响同步响应；当频率分布均值非零时，重置与固有集体旋转竞争，可将系统从旋转同步态驱动到锁相态。
AI.conclusion: 子系统重置是复杂网络中诱导和控制集体同步的有效机制，为通过局部控制实现全局相干提供了理论框架。

title: Interlocked Vortex Order in the Frustrated $A_3$V$_9$Te$_{13}$ Lattice ($A$=Cs,Rb)
summary: Recently synthesized $A_3$V$_9$Te$_{13}$ ($A$ = Cs, Rb) provides a unique platform for exploring the interplay between geometric frustration, magnetism, and correlated electronic states beyond conventional kagome systems. Based on first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that the frustrated V sublattice naturally stabilizes a robust vortex or anti-vortex antiferromagnetic ground state, whose total energy is substantially lower than all other configurations. In addition, the Heisenberg model analysis show strong constraints on the ground state magnetic configuration, such that fixing spin configuration of 1 triangle propagates and fixes all others. The vortex or anti-vortex phase hosts electronic structures reminiscent of kagome metals, including Dirac-like band crossings, van Hove singularities, and flat bands near the Fermi level. Owing to the noncollinear spin texture and quasi-two-dimensional magnetic character, the Néel temperature exhibits an extremely weak dependence on both the magnitude and direction of external magnetic fields, consistent with experimental observations. For Cs-based compound, the ground state band structure is metallic with 6 Weyl points in the BZ; while for the Rb-based compound, spin--orbit coupling opens an approximately 27-meV gap at ambient pressure due to the lifted C$_3$ symmetry. Our results establish $A_3$V$_9$Te$_{13}$ as a promising platform for studying frustration-driven chiral magnetism and its interplay with topological electronic states.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理与Heisenberg模型，揭示A3V9Te13中阻挫V亚晶格稳定涡旋/反涡旋反铁磁基态，并伴随类kagome电子结构与拓扑特征。
AI.motivation: 新合成的A3V9Te13 (A=Cs,Rb)为研究几何阻挫、磁性与关联电子态相互作用提供新平台，但其次磁基态与电子结构尚不清楚，需阐明阻挫磁性与拓扑电子态的耦合。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理计算确定磁基态；用Heisenberg模型分析基态自旋构型约束（固定一个三角形即传播确定全部）；分析能带（Dirac交叉、van Hove奇点、平带）；计算Néel温度对外磁场大小与方向的依赖；考虑自旋轨道耦合。
AI.result: 阻挫V亚晶格自然稳定涡旋/反涡旋反铁磁基态，能量显著低于其他构型；有类kagome电子结构；Néel温度对外场极弱依赖，与实验一致；Cs化合物金属性带6个Weyl点，Rb化合物因C3对称性破缺SOC打开约27 meV能隙。
AI.conclusion: A3V9Te13是研究阻挫驱动手性磁性及其与拓扑电子态相互作用的理想平台。

title: Large in-plane optical anisotropy in epitaxial CrN(113) films
summary: CrN, a transition-metal nitride crystallizing in the cubic rocksalt structure, exhibits a unique combination of mechanical robustness, semiconducting behavior, and thermoelectric functionality. To date, however, CrN has been synthesized primarily as polycrystalline material or as epitaxial films grown along high-symmetry orientations such as (001) and (111). Here, we prepare epitaxial CrN(113) films on AlN(11\bar{2}2) templates by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy. The low-symmetry interface and highly direction dependent lattice mismatch are expected to modify the physical properties of CrN relative to the bulk material. Indeed, variable-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry in the photon-energy range from 1.25 to 5 eV reveals a surprisingly strong polarization dependence of the optical response despite the nearly strain-free cubic crystal structure of the films. The pseudo-optical constants n and k differ by more than 10% for orthogonal in-plane polarizations throughout the investigated spectral range. We evaluate possible origins of this effect and conclude that it most likely arises from anisotropic surface morphology of CrN(113), which creates a metasurface acting as a subwavelength grating in the strongly absorbing regime.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用等离子体辅助分子束外延在AlN(11-22)模板上制备了CrN(113)外延薄膜，通过变角椭偏光谱发现尽管晶体近乎无应变且为立方结构，其光学响应却呈现强烈的偏振依赖性（n、k在正交面内偏振下差异超10%），并将此归因于(113)表面各向异性形貌形成的亚波长光栅型超表面。
AI.motivation: CrN兼具力学强度、半导体性与热电功能，但此前多以多晶或沿(001)、(111)等高对称取向的外延膜形式获得，低对称取向CrN的制备及其可能带来的新物理性质尚未被探索。
AI.method: 采用等离子体辅助分子束外延，在AlN(11-22)模板上生长CrN(113)外延薄膜；利用1.25–5 eV范围的变角光谱椭偏仪测量光学常数，并结合晶体结构与表面形貌分析探讨偏振依赖性的来源。
AI.result: 椭偏测量显示，在近乎无应变的立方晶体中，正交面内偏振方向的赝光学常数n和k在整个测量光谱范围内差异均超过10%，即出现出乎意料强的光学各向异性。
AI.conclusion: CrN(113)的光学各向异性最可能源于其各向异性的表面形貌——该形貌在强吸收区起到亚波长光栅式超表面的作用，而非源于晶格应变或本征电子结构。这提示低对称取向外延可通过表面形貌调控实现新颖的光学功能。

title: Diffusion-Induced Stabilization of Nonreciprocal Wealth Dynamics
summary: We study the stability of equal wealth shares in a spatial model combining local sharing, global redistribution, and random nonreciprocal interactions. On a two-dimensional square lattice in the infinite-system limit, the effect of local sharing depends on whether the influence of one site on another tends to have the same or opposite sign as the reverse influence. When these influences are nonnegatively correlated, diffusion reduces the redistribution required for stability, but a positive rate remains necessary. Negative correlations instead allow stability without redistribution, with the largest stability margin at finite diffusion and a return toward marginal stability at strong diffusion. This nonmonotonicity reflects a competition between spatial smoothing and the weakening of the stabilizing contribution of reciprocal anticorrelations. Equal shares can even remain stable under wealth-concentrating transfers, but only within an intermediate range of diffusion strengths.

AI.tldr: 研究二维格点上结合局部共享、全局再分配与随机非互惠相互作用的空间模型中均等财富份额的稳定性，发现稳定性取决于正向/反向影响的符号相关性。
AI.motivation: 探究在局部共享、全局再分配和随机非互惠相互作用共同作用的空间系统中，均等财富份额能否保持稳定，以及局部扩散（共享）与再分配如何影响稳定性。
AI.method: 构建二维方格上无限系统的空间模型，结合局部共享（扩散）、全局再分配与随机非互惠相互作用；按一站点对另一站点影响与反向影响的相关性（非负相关 vs 负相关）分类分析稳定性。
AI.result: 非负相关时，扩散减少所需再分配但正速率仍必要；负相关时无需再分配即可稳定，稳定裕度在有限扩散处最大、强扩散时回到边际稳定。均等份额在财富集中型转移下也能在中等扩散范围内保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 稳定性由空间平滑与互惠反相关稳定作用的竞争决定，呈现非单调性；扩散强度存在最优区间，均等财富份额的稳定性对参数高度敏感。

title: Microwave spectroscopic evidence of a moiré-commensurate electron crystal in monolayer graphene
summary: We probe the conductivity of the lowest Landau level of a moiré-aligned monolayer graphene device by broadband microwave transmission through a coplanar waveguide ($\sim$50 mK, 15.4--18 T), isolating the longitudinal channel through a low-minus-high frequency band difference $D(ν)$. We resolve a series of minima in $D(ν)$ that drift with field along lines of fixed carrier density rather than fixed Landau filling, the hallmark of moiré-commensurate electron crystals. The strongest minimum is present at every field and matches no fractional quantum Hall or integer Hofstadter state. It lies at band filling $s=1/3$, one electron for every three moiré cells---the generalized Wigner crystal that DaSilva, Jung, and MacDonald predict as the most favorable fixed-density ($t=0$) commensuration. The weaker minima fall near neighboring commensurate fillings.

AI.tldr: 通过微波传输测量moiré单层石墨烯最低朗道能级的电导，发现随固定载流子密度（而非固定朗道填充）漂移的电导极小，最强极小位于s=1/3处，对应预言的最稳定广义Wigner晶体。
AI.motivation: 探测moiré对齐单层石墨烯中最低朗道能级电导随磁场与载流子密度的演化，区分固定朗道填充与固定密度两类特征，寻找moiré公度电子晶体的实验证据。
AI.method: 在约50 mK、15.4–18 T下，用共面波导的宽带微波透射测量，通过低频减低高频的频带差分D(ν)分离出纵向通道信号，并追踪D(ν)极小随磁场的变化。
AI.result: D(ν)出现一系列极小，随磁场沿固定载流子密度线漂移而非固定朗道填充，是moiré公度电子晶体的标志；最强极小在各磁场下均存在，不对应任何分数量子霍尔或整数Hofstadter态，位于带填充s=1/3。较弱极小位于邻近公度填充附近。
AI.conclusion: s=1/3的极小（每三个moiré元胞一个电子）正是DaSilva、Jung和MacDonald预言的固定密度(t=0)下最有利的公度——广义Wigner晶体，为moiré体系中广义Wigner晶体的存在提供了输运证据。

title: VoroTypes: automated enumeration of Voronoi cell topologies for structural identification of complex crystals in atomistic simulations
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 pages of supplementary material
summary: VoroTypes enumerates, for an arbitrary crystal structure, the complete family of Voronoi cell topologies that can arise under small generic perturbations of atomic positions, and exports it as a topological filter for the VoroTop framework. This extends per-atom structural identification in molecular dynamics simulations, previously limited to a handful of simple reference structures, to complex crystals such as Frank--Kasper and Laves phases, with per-sublattice resolution. The package takes a standard crystallographic description (a CIF or POSCAR file) as input, applies exact symmetry reduction and validity pruning to accelerate the enumeration, and produces filters that load directly into the standalone VoroTop program or into OVITO. A library of pre-computed filters covers over a thousand structures from the Materials Project.

AI.tldr: VoroTypes 是一个工具包，可为任意晶体结构枚举在原子位置微小扰动下可能出现的全部 Voronoi 胞拓扑，并导出为 VoroTop 框架可用的拓扑过滤器，支持复杂晶体（如 Frank–Kasper 和 Laves 相）的逐子晶格结构识别。
AI.motivation: 分子动力学模拟中基于 VoroTop 的逐原子结构识别此前只限于少量简单参考结构，难以处理复杂晶体。需要一种能自动、完整地为任意晶体结构生成拓扑过滤器的方法。
AI.method: 以标准晶体学文件（CIF 或 POSCAR）为输入，进行精确对称性约简与有效性剪枝以加速枚举；枚举小扰动下所有可能的 Voronoi 胞拓扑，并导出为过滤器，可直接载入独立 VoroTop 程序或 OVITO。同时提供覆盖 Materials Project 一千多种结构的预计算过滤器库。
AI.result: 实现了对 Frank–Kasper、Laves 等复杂晶体的逐子晶格结构识别；输出过滤器可在 VoroTop 与 OVITO 中直接使用；附带超千种 Materials Project 结构的预计算过滤器库。
AI.conclusion: VoroTypes 将 Voronoi 拓扑结构识别从少数简单参考结构推广到任意复杂晶体，为分子动力学中的结构分析提供了通用、可扩展的工具。

title: Twist-controlled thermodynamic anomalies in bilayer q-state clock models
summary: Twist has emerged as a geometric means of controlling collective behavior across a wide range of physical systems. Whether it can qualitatively reorganize the thermodynamic anomalies of discrete spin models, and how such changes relate to microscopic spin configurations, remains less explored. Here we demonstrate twist-controlled thermodynamic anomalies in ferromagnetic bilayer q-state clock models using Monte Carlo simulations. With sufficiently strong interlayer coupling, twisting changes the number and structure of specific-heat peaks: a single peak can split into two, or two peaks can merge into one, depending on the number of allowed spin orientations. These changes are nonmonotonic in twist angle and occur over narrower parameter ranges, or are absent, for the larger q values examined. The accompanying spin textures and vortex distributions suggest a physical picture in which moire modulation of the interlayer coupling reorganizes local spin alignment and topological defects. In a representative case, peak splitting coincides with nearly uniform spin regions arranged on the moire scale and a reduced vortex population. These findings identify twist as a control parameter for the collective thermal response of discrete spin systems and raise the possibility of modified phase-transition behavior, including the emergence or suppression of an intermediate Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless phase.

AI.tldr: 该文用蒙特卡洛模拟研究铁磁双层q态时钟模型中由扭转角控制的热力学异常现象，发现足够强层间耦合下扭转可改变比热峰的数量与结构。
AI.motivation: 扭转已被广泛用于调控多种物理系统的集体行为，但其能否定性重组离散自旋模型的热力学异常，以及这些变化与微观自旋构型的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对铁磁双层q态时钟模型进行蒙特卡洛模拟，调节层间耦合强度、扭转角与允许自旋取向数q，并分析自旋织构与涡旋分布。
AI.result: 强层间耦合下扭转使单个比热峰分裂为两个，或使两个峰合并为一个，取决于q值；这些变化随扭转角非单调，且q越大参数区间越窄甚至消失。峰分裂对应莫尔尺度上近乎均匀的自旋区域与涡旋数量减少。
AI.conclusion: 扭转可作为离散自旋系统集体热响应的控制参量，并可能改变相变行为，包括诱导或抑制中间BKT相的出现。

title: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg diamond-like decorated honeycomb lattice in a magnetic field from the perspective of localized magnons and exact diagonalization
summary: The spin-$1/2$ quantum Heisenberg model on the diamond-decorated honeycomb lattice in a magnetic field is investigated using complementary analytical and numerical methods. The ground-state phase diagram comprises Lieb-Mattis ferrimagnetic, dimer-tetramer, monomer-dimer, spin-canted, and saturated paramagnetic phases, giving rise to characteristic magnetization plateaus, continuous and discontinuous field-induced transitions. In the highly frustrated regime, a localized-magnon approach based on an effective classical lattice-gas model provides an accurate description of the low-temperature magnetism and thermodynamics in agreement with numerical results. At intermediate frustration, finite-temperature calculations reveal characteristic specific-heat signatures of the field-induced transitions including the development of Ising critical behavior at the field-induced transition between the monomer-dimer and Lieb-Mattis ferrimagnetic phase.

AI.tldr: 研究了磁场下钻石修饰蜂窝晶格上的自旋1/2量子海森堡模型的基态相图与低温磁热性质，包含多种磁化平台与场诱导相变，并在高阻挫区用局域磁振子方法准确描述其磁性与热力学。
AI.motivation: 该体系具有高几何阻挫与平带特征，磁场可诱导丰富相变和磁化平台，但缺乏对基态相图、相变性质及有限温度热力学行为的系统刻画，尤其需要互补的解析与数值方法验证。
AI.method: 采用互补的解析与数值方法，包括局域磁振子（基于有效经典晶格气体模型）方法、数值精确对角化/有限温度计算等，计算基态相图、磁化曲线和比热。
AI.result: 基态相图包含Lieb-Mattis铁磁相、二聚体-四聚体相、单聚体-二聚体相、自旋倾斜相和饱和顺磁相，伴随特征磁化平台及连续与不连续场诱导相变；高阻挫区局域磁振子方法给出与数值一致的低温磁性与热力学；中间阻挫区比热显示相变特征，并在单聚体-二聚体与Lieb-Mattis铁磁相之间的场诱导转变处出现Ising临界行为。
AI.conclusion: 该模型呈现高度丰富的场诱导相变与磁化平台结构，局域磁振子方法在高阻挫区可靠，中间阻挫区的场诱导相变具有Ising普适类特征，为平带阻挫磁体研究提供参考。

title: Sluggish random walks with resetting: nonequilibrium aspects
summary: We derive exact analytical expressions for the fixed-time probability distribution and the Laplace transform of the distribution of the first-passage time to reach a target for a sluggish random walk in one dimension subject to two different types of stochastic resetting: stochastic resetting at random Poisson-distributed times, and resetting implemented whenever a position threshold is reached. The optimal resetting rate that minimises the mean first-passage time is obtained as a function of the sluggishness parameter, while under threshold resetting the mean first-passage time to the origin is found to increase monotonically with the threshold. We also characterise the occupation-time statistics, retrieving a Lamperti-type distribution under free dynamics and under Poissonian resetting at rate for short observation times, a Gaussian distribution centred at half for long observation times, and a distinct deterministic limit under threshold resetting. To further characterise nonequilibrium aspects of resetting, we evaluate the distribution and mean of the cost incurred per reset under Poissonian resetting, and the cost rate under threshold resetting, for different (linear, power-law, exponential) cost functions, and find the same critical behaviour of the cost rate in the limits of a vanishing resetting rate and an infinite threshold, respectively. Numerical simulations validate with excellent accuracy our analytical formulae.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了一维slow走子在两种重置机制（泊松随机重置与阈值重置）下的首达时间分布与Laplace变换的精确解析式，给出最优重置速率和占据时间统计，并刻画重置成本。
AI.motivation: 随机重置被广泛用于加速搜索过程，但以往研究多针对标准随机游走；对于具有“sluggish”（缓慢）标度行为、位置分布宽度随时间对数值或次幂增长的随机游走，其在重置下的首达时间、占据时间及能量成本等统计性质尚缺乏精确解析结果。
AI.method: 考虑一维sluggish随机游走，分别引入(a)Poisson分布随机时刻的重置和(b)到达位置阈值时的重置两种机制。解析求解固定时刻概率分布与首达时间Laplace变换的精确表达式；求最小化平均首达时间的最优重置速率（作为sluggishness参数的函数）；分析占据时间统计（自由动力学与Poisson重置下短时间呈Lamperti型分布、长时间呈以1/2为均值的高斯分布，阈值重置下趋于确定性极限）；对线性、幂律、指数三类成本函数计算单次重置成本分布、均值与阈值重置下的成本率；并以数值模拟验证。
AI.result: 获得精确解析式：最优重置速率显式依赖sluggishness参数；阈值重置下到达原点的平均首达时间随阈值单调增加；占据时间在三种情形下分别呈现Lamperti分布、高斯分布与确定性极限；单次重置成本分布与均值可解析给出，成本率在重置速率趋于零与阈值趋于无穷两个极限下表现相同的临界行为。数值模拟与解析结果高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作完整刻画了两种重置机制下sluggish随机游走的首达时间、占据时间与成本统计，揭示了普通游走与sluggish游走在重置加速与成本临界行为上的对应关系，为设计搜索策略与评估重置代价提供了解析依据。

title: Coherent and Incoherent Time-Resolved Diffuse Scattering Intensity from First Principles
summary: Time-resolved diffuse scattering from X-ray free-electron lasers and ultrafast electron diffraction gives access to the nonequilibrium lattice dynamics of photoexcited solids in reciprocal space. Existing interpretations have often relied on simplified models. Here we present a first-principles formulation of the time-dependent first-order diffuse intensity in which coherent and incoherent contributions emerge on equal footing. By assuming the probe-pulse coherence time to be longer than the characteristic electronic timescales, but shorter than those of the ionic motion, we work in the density-matrix formalism and derive equations of motion for the displacement-displacement correlators in a basis of instantaneous, out-of-equilibrium Born-Oppenheimer normal modes. We show how the incoherent contribution, governed by the phonon occupations, and a coherent contribution, governed by the anomalous phonon correlators, emerge. The non-trivial coherent dynamics is shown to be induced both by the photoinduced phonon-frequency shift and by electron-phonon scattering off the nonequilibrium carrier distribution. We implement the resulting equations using Wannier interpolation in the \textsc{EPI}q code and apply them to photoexcited germanium. The calculated diffuse intensity reproduces both the oscillation frequencies and the rising incoherent background observed experimentally, opening the way to a systematic interpretation of time-resolved diffuse scattering in ultrafast experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间分辨第一性原理漫散射强度理论，将相干与非相干贡献统一处理，并在光激发锗中成功再现实验观测的振荡频率与上升的非相干背景。
AI.motivation: 以往对XFEL和超快电子衍射的时间分辨漫散射分析常依赖简化模型，缺乏一致描述相干与非相干贡献的第一性原理框架，因而难以系统解释光激发固体的非平衡晶格动力学。
AI.method: 假设探测脉冲相干时间长于电子特征时间但短于离子运动时间，在密度矩阵形式下，以瞬态非平衡玻恩-奥本海默简正模为基，推导位移-位移关联子的运动方程，得到由声子占据数支配的非相干项和由反常声子关联子支配的相干项；并在EPIq代码中用Wannier插值实现，应用于光激发锗。
AI.result: 相干动力学由光致声子频率移动和偏离非平衡载流子分布的电子-声子散射共同诱导；计算所得漫散射强度同时再现了实验观测的振荡频率和上升的非相干背景。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为超快实验中的时间分辨漫散射提供了系统性的第一性原理解释框架。

title: Exciton superfluidity in two-dimensional bilayers at zero and high magnetic fields
summary: We study interlayer exciton superfluidity versus layer separation in two-dimensional electron-hole bilayers at zero magnetic field and quantum Hall bilayers at total filling $ν_T=1$. Unscreened Hartree-Fock theory predicts coherence at every finite separation, with an energy scale decaying inversely with separation at large distances. We examine how screening, correlations, and spatial instabilities modify this prediction. At zero field, we solve the linearized gap equation with the full momentum and frequency dependence of the interaction screened within the random-phase approximation, without an imposed cutoff. The apparent plasmon enhancement of pairing in the ladder approximation is largely cancelled by the second-order crossed-rung correction. Static screening determines the leading pairing exponent in the controlled high-density limit at fixed separation. At large separation, the pairing scale falls exponentially with squared separation while the instability persists. Extending this result to fixed density assumes Fermi-liquid layers and higher-order dynamical corrections subleading to the static pairing interaction. At high field, we obtain an analytic uniform Hartree-Fock saddle point in the lowest Landau level, coherent at every finite separation. Within Hartree-Fock theory, its finite-wave-vector collective-mode instability favors an excitonic supersolid, distinguishing loss of spatial uniformity from loss of coherence. We conjecture that the quantum Hall bilayer evolves continuously toward weak pairing of composite fermions, with a scale far below the mean-field prediction at large separation. This suppression could produce an apparent critical separation at finite temperature without a ground-state quantum phase transition. The comparison separates the existence, energy scale, and spatial stability of interlayer coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了零磁场下电子-空穴双层与总填充ν_T=1量子霍尔双层中层间激子超流随层间距的变化，分别用RPA屏蔽线性化gap方程与LLL Hartree-Fock分析屏蔽、关联与空间不稳定性对相干性的修正。
AI.motivation: 无屏蔽Hartree-Fock理论预言任意有限层间距下都存在相干性且能标随间距反比衰减，但真实体系中屏蔽、关联效应和空间不稳定性会如何改变这一预言尚不清楚，需要厘清"相干性存在性、能标大小与空间稳定性"这三件不同的事。
AI.method: 零场情形：在RPA屏蔽下求解保留完整动量与频率依赖的线性化gap方程，不施加截断；检验ladder近似中plasmon增强配对与二阶crossed-rung修正的相消；分析静态屏蔽对高密度极限下配对指数的控制。高场情形：在最低朗道能级中构造解析的均匀Hartree-Fock鞍点，并分析其有限波矢集体模不稳定性。
AI.result: 零场下ladder近似的plasmon配对增强大部分被crossed-rung修正抵消；高密度固定间距极限由静态屏蔽决定主导配对指数；大间距下配对能标随间距平方指数衰减但失稳仍持续。高场LLL Hartree-Fock鞍点在任意有限间距下均相干，但其集体模不稳定倾向于激子超固态，从而把空间均匀性丧失与相干性丧失区分开。
AI.conclusion: 层间相干的存在性、能标大小与空间稳定性是三个可分离的问题；作者猜测量子霍尔双层连续演化向复合费米子的弱配对，能标远低于大间距平均场预言，可在有限温度下产生表观临界间距而无需基态量子相变。

title: Partial Localization and Multifractality in Heterogeneous Population Growth with Resetting
summary: We study a model of heterogeneous multiplicative growth with mean-field redistribution and independent local stochastic resetting. The model describes populations or wealth distributed over sites with quenched growth-rate heterogeneity, while resets represent random local extinction or bankruptcy events. At large redistribution or resetting rate, we find a delocalized phase and we compute the growth rate as well as the stationary distribution of the population of a given site. We show that reset-free growth episodes generate power-law stationary tails with site-dependent exponents. For weak resetting and redistribution, favorable sites can undergo long reset-free episodes and localize. This produces a partially localized phase, in which a finite fraction of the total population is carried by a small set of sites whose identity changes on an $O(1)$ time scale within a subextensive pool of $N^{u^\star}$ favorable candidates, with $0<u^\star<1$. We derive the corresponding growth rate from a saddle point analysis, and show that the averaged stationary fractions display multifractal behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有平均场再分配与独立局部随机重置的异质乘性生长模型，发现强重置/再分配下为退局域相，弱重置下出现部分局域相，并在候选子池中发生局域化，平均稳态分布呈多重分形。
AI.motivation: 人口或财富在各站点上分布，且各站点生长率存在淬火异质性；局部重置对应随机灭绝或破产事件。作者希望刻画重置、再分配与异质生长共同作用下的相变行为和稳态分布特性。
AI.method: 构建异质乘性生长+平均场再分配+独立局部随机重置的模型；在强重置/再分配极限下解析计算生长率与单站点人口的稳态分布；对弱重置情形用鞍点分析推导生长率，并分析局域化的候选子池规模与稳态平均分数。
AI.result: 强重置/再分配时体系处于退局域相，可解析给出生长率与稳态分布；无重置的生长时段产生位点依赖指数的幂律稳态尾。弱重置/再分配时，优势站点可经历长时间无重置生长而局域化，形成部分局域相：有限比例总人口由少量站点承载，其身份在O(1)时间尺度变化，候选池规模为N^{u*}（0<u*<1）。由鞍点分析得到生长率，平均稳态分数表现出多重分形行为。
AI.conclusion: 重置与再分配的强度控制局域化相变：强重置导致退局域，弱重置产生部分局域化，且平均稳态分布具有多重分形谱。该结果为理解随机灭绝/破产下的异质增长群体分布提供了解析框架。

title: Putting a Temperature on Electron Correlation
summary: It is common wisdom that a better understanding of how to quantify electron correlation should lead to more efficient treatments of the correlation problem. Here, we not only substantiate this view but turn it into a concrete, systematic framework for ground states. Since prominent correlation measures such as the nonfreeness depend only on the one-particle reduced density matrix, modeling the correlation energy as a function of such a measure naturally places the framework within reduced density matrix functional theory, while keeping the cost at mean-field level. Strikingly, the variable conjugate to the measure emerges as a ``correlation temperature'', thereby connecting correlation measures, functional theory, and effective temperatures. The framework rationalizes methods such as i-DMFT, and we illustrate its key concepts analytically for the Hubbard dimer and numerically for small molecular systems. This brings a fundamental question within reach: how much of the correlation problem can be solved at mean-field cost?

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个系统框架，将电子关联能量建模为关联度量（如nonfreeness）的函数，在约化密度矩阵泛函理论(1-RDMFT)内以平均场成本处理关联问题，并引入"关联温度"这一共轭变量。
AI.motivation: 人们普遍认为更好理解如何量化电子关联将带来更高效的关联处理方法，但这一直觉此前缺乏具体、系统的理论框架支撑。
AI.method: 由于nonfreeness等主要关联度量只依赖一阶约化密度矩阵，作者将其作为泛函变量，把关联能量写成该度量的函数（属1-RDMFT框架，保持平均场成本）；分析其共轭变量并识别为"关联温度"；在Hubbard二聚体上解析验证，在小分子体系上数值验证，并与其他方法(如i-DMFT)联系。
AI.result: 共轭于关联度量的变量呈现为"关联温度"，从而将关联度量、泛函理论与有效温度联系起来；该框架为i-DMFT等方法提供了理论解释；在Hubbard二聚体上给出解析说明，小分子体系上得到数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把"关联问题能在多大程度上以平均场成本解决"这一根本问题变为可探讨的问题，并为低成本、系统化的关联处理提供了新路径。

title: A rigid commensurate host and a defect that switches: vacancies in the frustrated alternating spin-(1, 1/2) Heisenberg chain
summary: The alternating spin-$(1,\tfrac12)$ Heisenberg chain with a frustrating next-nearest-neighbor coupling $J_2$ loses its Lieb--Mattis moment through a discontinuous transition to a singlet whose nature was left open. Using an SU(2)-symmetric density-matrix renormalization group, in which the total spin is a quantum-number label, we identify that phase and follow a single vacancy through it. The total spin collapses directly from $S=L/4$ to $S=0$, with no partially polarized window. The singlet phase is critical: its singlet--triplet gap closes as $1/L$, its entanglement entropy grows logarithmically with a central charge $c\simeq1.8$, and its modulation wavevector, extrapolated from $L=80$ to $200$, is commensurate at $3π/4$ and independent of $J_2$ to $5\times10^{-5}$. Removing the central $S=1$ site switches the ground state of the doped chain from a triplet to a singlet at $J_2^{\ast}=0.3068(3)$, where the host shows no feature; the triplet is not bound to the vacancy but spread over one of the two segments it leaves. The transmission of correlations through the vacancy saturates at a finite value below $J_2^{\ast}$, $T(\infty)=0.102(15)$ and $0.036(9)$ at $J_2=0.28$ and $0.30$, and the cut-chain law $T\propto L^{-1}$ is excluded on both sides. We also show that the longitudinal correlator is not an observable in a triplet sector.

AI.tldr: 该文用SU(2)对称DMRG研究交替spin-(1,1/2)海森堡链在阻挫J2作用下的相变，并追踪单个空位的影响。
AI.motivation: 此前研究已知该链通过一级不连续相变失去Lieb-Mattis磁矩进入一个单态相，但该单态的性质（是否有部分极化窗口、是否临界）尚不明确，掺杂/空位行为也未澄清。
AI.method: 采用总自旋作为量子数标签的SU(2)对称密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG），确定相图并追踪单空位；计算自旋隙、纠缠熵、调制波矢及关联透射率。
AI.result: 总自旋从S=L/4直接塌缩到S=0，无部分极化窗口。单态相临界：单态-三重态隙按1/L闭合，纠缠熵对数增长，中心电荷c≈1.8，调制波矢在3π/4处公度且与J2无关（5×10⁻⁵精度）。去除中心S=1格点后，掺杂链基态在J2*=0.3068(3)处由三重态变为单态，而母体无特征；三重态不局域于空位而分布在空位两侧之一；关联透射率在J2*以下饱和于有限值T(∞)=0.102(15)和0.036(9)，排除断链的L⁻¹律。另证明纵向关联在三重态扇区不是可观测量。
AI.conclusion: 交替spin-(1,1/2)链的阻挫相变导致一个公度临界单态相；空位诱导的束缚转变与体相无关，且空位关联透射为有限值，挑战了简单断链图像。

title: $d$-wave superconductivity in quintuple-layer bulk superconductor La$_6$Ni$_5$O$_{12}$
summary: The recent realization of bulk superconductivity in the quintuple-layer nickelate La$_6$Ni$_5$O$_{12}$ opens new opportunities to probe the pairing symmetry of the reduced Ruddlesden--Popper (RP) nickelate family. Using an effective five-layer Hubbard model and variational Monte Carlo calculations, we find that a spin-singlet $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave state is energetically favored, while extended-$s$-wave pairing is strongly suppressed. Based on the optimized superconducting state, we further calculate several experimentally accessible observables. The tunneling density of states exhibits a characteristic V-shaped low-energy spectrum, the superfluid density shows a linear low-temperature depletion, the Knight shift decreases below $T_c$, and the spin-lattice relaxation rate follows $1/T_1T\propto T^2$, together providing consistent signatures of a clean nodal superconductor. Extending the same framework to related reduced RP nickelates, we find a robust $d$-wave tendency in infinite-layer LaNiO$_{2}$, while trilayer La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{8}$ at its nominal filling lies close to the boundary between $d$-wave superconductivity and a non-superconducting state. These results establish bulk La$_6$Ni$_5$O$_{12}$ as a promising platform for determining the pairing symmetry of nickelate superconductors and suggest a common $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave pairing tendency across the reduced RP nickelate family.

AI.tldr: 采用五层Hubbard模型与变分蒙特卡洛方法，发现La6Ni5O12基态为自旋单态dx2-y2波超导，多项可观测量的理论预言一致指向干净节点超导体，并指出还原型RP镍酸盐家族普遍存在d波配对倾向。
AI.motivation: La6Ni5O12中体超导的发现为研究还原型Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐的配对对称性提供了新平台，但其配对对称性尚未确定。
AI.method: 构建有效五层Hubbard模型，使用变分蒙特卡洛（VMC）计算比较不同配对通道的能量，并在优化后的超导态上计算隧道谱、超流密度、Knight位移与自旋-晶格弛豫率等可观测量；再将同一框架推广到LaNiO2与La4Ni3O8。
AI.result: dx2-y2波能量占优，扩展s波被强烈抑制；隧道密度呈现V形低能谱，超流密度低温线性耗尽，Knight位移在T_c以下下降，1/T1T∝T^2，共同构成干净节点超导的一致证据。无限层LaNiO2显示稳健d波倾向，三层La4Ni3O8在名义填充下处于d波超导与非超导态边界附近。
AI.conclusion: La6Ni5O12是判定镍酸盐超导配对对称性的理想平台，还原型RP镍酸盐家族可能存在共同的dx2-y2波配对倾向。

title: Pt-induced semimetallic transport and enhanced thermoelectric response in the half-Heusler alloy YNi_{0.5}Pt_{0.5}Bi
summary: Half-Heusler alloys provide a versatile platform for tuning electronic and thermal transport through chemical substitution. Here, we investigate the thermoelectric and magnetotransport properties of spark-plasma-sintered YNi_{0.5}Pt_{0.5}Bi. Partial substitution of Ni by Pt drives YNiBi toward semimetallic transport, characterized by hole-dominated conduction, a low Hall carrier concentration of $\mathrm{1.9 \times 10^{19} cm^{-3}}$, and a sizeable nonsaturating magnetoresistance of 18$\%$ at 300 K under 14 T. Compared with YNiBi, Pt alloying increases the room-temperature Seebeck coefficient from approximately 90 to 130 $\mathrm{μV K^{-1}}$, while reducing the thermal conductivity to 3.15 $\mathrm{W m^{-1} K^{-1}}$. Single-parabolic-band analysis indicates an enhanced carrier effective mass, resulting in a room-temperature power factor of 13.7 $\mathrm{μW cm^{-1} K^{-2}}$ and a figure of merit ($zT$= 0.13). First-principles calculations further show a Pt-induced closing of the electronic band gap and a low density of states near the Fermi level, consistent with the experimentally observed semimetal-like transport. These results demonstrate that Ni/Pt alloying provides an effective route for simultaneously tuning the electronic, magnetotransport, and thermoelectric properties of YNiBi-based half-Heusler compounds.

AI.tldr: 通过在YNiBi中用Pt部分替代Ni，合金化使材料趋向半金属输运，同时提升Seebeck系数、降低热导，实现室温zT=0.13的热电与磁输运协同调控。
AI.motivation: 半Heusler合金是调控电子与热输运的灵活平台，作者希望探究Ni/Pt化学替代对YNiBi基化合物热电与磁输运性质的影响，寻找同时优化电、磁、热性质的途径。
AI.method: 采用放电等离子烧结（SPS）制备YNi0.5Pt0.5Bi样品，测量热电与磁输运性质（Hall、磁阻、Seebeck、热导率），并用单抛物带模型分析载流子有效质量，辅以第一性原理计算电子结构。
AI.result: Pt替代使输运变为空穴主导的半金属型，Hall载流子浓度低（1.9×10^19 cm^-3），14 T、300 K下非饱和磁阻达18%；室温Seebeck系数由约90提高到130 μV/K，热导率降至3.15 W/m·K；有效质量增强，功率因子13.7 μW/cm·K^2，zT=0.13。计算显示Pt诱导带隙闭合、费米面附近态密度低，与实验一致。
AI.conclusion: Ni/Pt合金化是同时调控YNiBi基半Heusler化合物电子、磁输运和热电性能的有效手段。

title: Local wave-packet spectroscopy of the Drude weight in Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids
summary: We investigate wave packets generated by a local pulse electric field in a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid (TLL) with a U(1) charge $q$. Bosonization shows that a local pulse field creates two counterpropagating packets with opposite accumulated charges $\pm qK$ and velocity $v$, where $K$ and $v$ are the TLL parameter and velocity. The packet motion produces a linearly growing charge polarization $P(t)=2 qDt$ in the conducting TLL at non-equilibrium, allowing the Drude weight $D=vK$ to be extracted from real-time local dynamics. We test this local-packet description by time-dependent variational principle simulations of the spin-1/2 XXZ chain. The simulations visualize the density, current, energy, and entanglement profiles in the space-time plane and confirm the predicted packet charge and propagation velocity. We also show that excess energy and entanglement remaining near the pulse region are suppressed in the weak-pulse limit. Finally, the Drude weight obtained from the packet-induced polarization agrees with the exact Bethe-ansatz result, demonstrating local-packet spectroscopy of intrinsic transport in a TLL.

AI.tldr: A local pulse field in a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid creates two counterpropagating bosonic packets carrying opposite charge ±qK; their motion yields a linearly growing polarization P(t)=2qDt, allowing the Drude weight D=vK to be read out from real-time local dynamics, confirmed by TDVP simulations of the XXZ chain.
AI.motivation: The paper aims to understand how a local pulsed electric field excites a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid and whether the resulting real-time local dynamics can serve as a probe of intrinsic transport properties such as the Drude weight.
AI.method: Bosonization analysis shows that the local pulse splits into two counterpropagating packets with accumulated charge ±qK and velocity v. The prediction is then tested with time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) simulations of the spin-1/2 XXZ chain, visualizing density, current, energy and entanglement in space-time.
AI.result: Simulations confirm the predicted packet charges and propagation velocity, show that excess energy and entanglement near the pulse region are suppressed in the weak-pulse limit, and the Drude weight extracted from the packet-induced polarization agrees with the exact Bethe-ansatz result.
AI.conclusion: A local pulse acts as a spectroscopic probe of TLL transport: packet-induced polarization provides a reliable, real-time route to the Drude weight, establishing "local-packet spectroscopy" of intrinsic transport in a Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid.

title: Extended strange metal and superconductivity in partially filled moiré Hubbard bands
summary: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. Bandwidth-tuned Mott transitions and complex phase diagrams mimicking those of high-temperature superconductors have been demonstrated near a weak Mott insulating state at half-band-filling. The platform also provides an opportunity to explore the physics of a partially filled Hubbard band at doping densities far away from the Mott insulator, a regime that has remained largely unexplored. Here we report the emergence of an extended strange metal (ESM), in both doping density and twist angle, in a partially filled Hubbard band of twisted bilayer WSe2. The ESM is in the clean limit, persists down to about 50mK, and spans over multiple symmetry-breaking ground states; it also appears only at small twist angles, where electronic correlations are strong. These observations distinguish the state from the reported strange metals associated with quantum criticality and favor the viewpoint that it is an intrinsic state of matter. We also report the observation of a new superconducting dome being developed from the ESM but far away from both the Mott insulating state and the van Hove singularity of the material. Our work opens the door to exploring the new regime of partially filled Hubbard bands in the clean limit.

AI.tldr: 在扭角双层WSe2的部分填充Hubbard带中，远离Mott绝缘体处发现一种延展的奇异金属（ESM），其在掺杂浓度和扭角上都成片存在，并在其基础上发育出新的超导穹顶。
AI.motivation: 莫尔半导体可实现Hubbard模型，已有工作集中在半填充附近的弱Mott绝缘体及带宽调控的Mott转变。而远离Mott绝缘体、部分填充Hubbard带的物理几乎未被探索，本文旨在进入这一新区域。
AI.method: 在扭角双层WSe2器件中，通过调节掺杂浓度与扭角，系统测量输运性质，考察ESM出现的参数范围、温度依赖（低至约50 mK）、洁净度、与对称破缺基态的关系，以及其上的超导行为。
AI.result: ESM在掺杂浓度和扭角上均有延展区域；处于洁净极限，可持续到约50 mK；跨越多个对称破缺基态；仅在小扭角（强电子关联）下出现；并在ESM基础上观察到新的超导穹顶，其远离Mott绝缘态和van Hove奇点。
AI.conclusion: 该ESM不同于量子临界性驱动的奇异金属，更可能是物质的一种内禀态；该工作为在洁净极限下研究部分填充Hubbard带开辟了新方向。

title: From picometre displacements to a three-dimensional lattice gas of polar skyrmions
summary: Polar skyrmions, the electric analogues of magnetic skyrmions, form arrays in PbTiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices that are known to be only short-range ordered, but how this disordered ensemble is organized in three dimensions, and how its microscopic structure underlies this organization, have remained largely inaccessible. Here, using three-dimensional difference pair distribution function (3D-ΔPDF) analysis of X-ray diffuse scattering, we show that the polar skyrmion bubbles form a three-dimensional lattice gas: they occupy discrete sites, but their order extends over only a few neighbours and is two to three times stronger across the SrTiO3 spacers than within a layer. This interlayer coupling is consistent with the polarization of the bubbles extending into the spacers. Within each bubble, the polarization rotates in a predominantly Néel-type manner, and Pb and Ti rotate together with comparable picometre displacements, demonstrating that both A- and B-site cations take part in the polar distortion.

AI.tldr: 利用三维差分对分布函数(3D-ΔPDF)分析X射线漫散射，揭示PbTiO3/SrTiO3超晶格中极性斯格明子气泡构成三维"格气"格点占据态，层间耦合强于层内，且气泡内极化为Néel型，A位与B位阳离子共同参与极性畸变。
AI.motivation: 极性斯格明子阵列在PbTiO3/SrTiO3超晶格中已知仅短程有序，但其三维组织方式及微观结构基础此前难以获得。
AI.method: 对X射线漫散射进行三维差分对分布函数(3D-ΔPDF)分析。
AI.result: 极性斯格明子气泡构成三维格气：占据离散格点，序仅延伸数个近邻；跨SrTiO3间隔层的序比层内强2–3倍，与气泡极化延伸进入间隔层一致。气泡内极化以Néel型为主旋转，Pb和Ti以皮米级可比位移共同转动。
AI.conclusion: 极性斯格明子是由A位和B位阳离子共同贡献的短程有序三维格气，层间耦合主导其组织，为理解极性拓扑结构的集体行为提供微观依据。

title: Parafermions in polarized $ν=2/3$ Fractional Quantum (Anomalous) Hall Heterostructures
summary: Motivated by recent experimental signatures of fractional Chern insulators in 2D quantum materials, we investigate the realization of $\mathbb Z_3$ parafermion zero modes (PZMs) on edges of spin-polarized $ν=2/3$ fractional quantum Hall states which are proximitized by superconductors. Unlike the spin-unpolarized Halperin state, the polarized $ν=2/3$ edge contains counterpropagating electron and fractional quasihole modes, giving rise to a plethora of competing tunneling and pairing processes. We focus on the vicinity of the fixed point where these modes reorganize into decoupled charge and neutral sectors, with the neutral sector describing an emergent dipole degree of freedom. Using bosonization and renormalization group analysis, we lay out the parameter space in which the interedge dipole interactions gap the neutral sector to stabilize one dominant tunneling and one dominant pairing channel resulting in a double sine-Gordon model in the charge sector which supports $\mathbb{Z}_3$ PZMs at domain walls. We discuss both clean and disordered systems. In clean systems this mechanism requires a certain degree of control of the interaction strength and range. In contrast, disorder can provide a more generic route: While short-ranged, edge-uncorrelated disorder % on the two edges suppresses the simultaneous pinning required for stable parafermion modes, when the disorder on the two edges is sufficiently correlated, as expected for smooth disorder potentials, the parameter regime hosting PZMs increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在自旋极化 ν=2/3 分数量子霍尔态边界、邻近超导的情况下实现 Z3 仲费米子零模(PZM)的条件，利用玻色化与重整化群分析给出稳定 PZM 的参数空间。
AI.motivation: 近期二维量子材料中分数量子陈绝缘体的实验迹象激发了对仲费米子零模的探索；与自旋未极化的 Halperin 态不同，极化 ν=2/3 边缘含反向传播的电子与分数量子空穴模式，产生众多竞争性隧穿与配对过程，需要厘清哪些参数区能稳定 PZM。
AI.method: 聚焦模式重组为解耦电荷与中性部门的固定点附近（中性部门描述涌现偶极自由度）；采用玻色化与重整化群分析，划定边缘间偶极相互作用使中性部门能隙化、从而留下一个主导隧穿通道与一个主导配对通道的参数空间，得到电荷部门中的双正弦-戈登模型，其在畴壁处支持 Z3 PZM；并分别讨论干净与无序系统。
AI.result: 干净系统中该机制需要一定程度的相互作用强度与作用范围控制；短程、两边缘不关联的无序会抑制稳定 PZM 所需的同步钉扎，而两边缘充分关联的无序（如平滑无序势）反而会扩大支持 PZM 的参数区间。
AI.conclusion: 自旋极化 ν=2/3 分数量子霍尔边缘是承载 Z3 仲费米子零模的可行平台；干净极限需精细调控，而关联无序提供更普适的实现路径。

title: Band-Resolved Superconducting Gaps via the Thermal Hall Effect in CeRu2
summary: Standard bulk probes of multiband superconductors cannot assign pairing gaps to specific electron or hole Fermi surfaces. Here we show that thermal Hall transport ($κ_{xy}$), constrained by specific heat and normal-state magnetotransport, resolves this ambiguity in the compensated heavy-fermion superconductor CeRu$_2$. Fixing the gap magnitudes ($Δ_e/k_B\approx 13$K, $Δ_h/k_B\approx 8$K) and band mobilities completely determines the electronic degrees of freedom in $κ_{xx}$ and $κ_{xy}$. A low-field sign reversal in $κ_{xy}$ places the larger gap on the heavy Ce $4f$ electron sheets and the smaller on the hole sheets.

AI.tldr: 热霍尔输运($\kappa_{xy}$)结合比热与正常态磁输运,可分辨补偿型重费米子超导体CeRu$_2$中各费米面的配对能隙。
AI.motivation: 常规体探针无法将配对能隙分配到具体的电子或空穴费米面,多带超导体中这存在根本性模糊。
AI.method: 以比热和正常态磁输运作为约束,测量并分析热霍尔电导$\kappa_{xy}$与纵向热导$\kappa_{xx}$;固定能隙幅值($\Delta_e/k_B\approx13$K、$\Delta_h/k_B\approx8$K)与各带迁移率后,完全确定电子的自由度。
AI.result: $\kappa_{xy}$在低场出现符号反转,据此将较大能隙归属重的Ce $4f$电子片,较小能隙归属空穴片。
AI.conclusion: 热霍尔输运是一种可消除多带超导体能隙-费米面归属模糊的有效体探针。

title: Thermodynamically Consistent Machine Learning for Fracture Prediction in Heterogeneous Materials
summary: Understanding fracture behavior is critical for assessing the structural integrity and longevity. Highly time-consuming physics-based fracture simulations motivate the development of machine-learning-based fracture evolution prediction with surrogate models. However, most existing machine-learning models for fracture prediction operate as black boxes and require large training datasets to generalize reliably. In this work, Thermodynamically Consistent Latent Dynamics Identification (tLaSDI) for parametric systems is introduced to predict fracture patterns and evolution in heterogeneous materials. The model learns the thermodynamic state variable in a lower-dimensional latent space using parametric GENERIC Formalism-Informed Neural Networks (pGFINNs) that enforce key thermodynamic principles, such as total energy conservation and entropy generation. This model embeds physics into the neural network architecture using a hard-constraint method that inherently complies with the underlying thermodynamic principles. The proposed tLaSDI-pGFINNs is further enhanced by a Geometry-Conditioned Autoencoder in learning the geometry configuration for effective geometry-guided learning. The energy and entropy evolution histories demonstrate that the model preserves the thermodynamic constraints on unseen testing samples. The results further show that tLaSDI-pGFINNs can more accurately capture both fracture patterns and the subsequent fracture evolution than the purely data-driven Autoencoder Long Short-Term Memory (AE-LSTM) model.

AI.tldr: 提出tLaSDI-pGFINNs模型，在低维潜空间中结合热力学硬约束预测异质材料的断裂模式与演化。
AI.motivation: 物理断裂模拟耗时巨大，需机器学习代理模型；但现有模型多为黑箱且依赖大量训练数据，泛化性差。
AI.method: 基于参数化GENERIC形式主义神经网络(pGFINNs)学习潜空间热力学状态变量，用硬约束方法将能量守恒与熵产生等原理嵌入网络架构；并用几何条件自编码器(Geometry-Conditioned Autoencoder)进行几何引导学习。
AI.result: 能量与熵演化历史表明模型在未见测试样本上仍满足热力学约束；相比纯数据驱动的AE-LSTM，能更准确地捕捉断裂模式及后续演化。
AI.conclusion: 热力学一致的潜动力学方法可有效、可靠地预测异质材料断裂演化，优于纯数据驱动方法。

title: Second-Order Homogenization of Particulate Elastomeric Composites for Structural-Scale Damage Analysis
summary: Damage prediction in particulate elastomeric composites is challenging due to the strong material heterogeneity, nearly incompressible behavior of the matrix, and the presence of localized stress concentrations arising from matrix-inclusion interactions. In the present work, a computational framework is developed for damage propagation analysis of particulate elastomeric composite structures. The effective constitutive response of the heterogeneous material is first determined using the second-order homogenization method. The resulting homogenized response is subsequently used to identify equivalent hyperelastic material parameters for structural simulations. A three-parameter isotropic damage model is incorporated to capture damage-induced softening. A mixed displacement-pressure finite element formulation, is used to alleviate volumetric locking associated with nearly incompressible property of elastomers. The proposed framework is validated through full-scale simulations and homogenized response involving composites with varying inclusion volume fractions. Numerical investigations demonstrate that the homogenized models is able to reproduce the global force-displacement response within 2% error and damage evolution characteristics of the heterogeneous composites while significantly reducing the computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一个颗粒弹性体复合材料损伤传播的计算框架：用二阶均匀化获得等效本构，再拟合等效超弹性参数并引入三参数各向同性损伤模型，配合混合位移-压力有限元缓解体积锁死，可在显著降低计算成本的同时以2%以内误差再现整体力-位移响应。
AI.motivation: 颗粒弹性体复合材料的损伤预测困难，原因在于材料强非均匀性、基体近乎不可压缩，以及基体-夹杂相互作用引起的局部应力集中。直接对全尺度异质结构做损伤分析计算代价过高。
AI.method: 1）采用二阶均匀化方法确定异质材料的等效本构响应；2）由均匀化响应辨识等效超弹性材料参数用于结构级仿真；3）引入三参数各向同性损伤模型刻画损伤导致的软化；4）采用混合位移-压力有限元格式，缓解弹性体近不可压缩带来的体积锁死。
AI.result: 通过不同夹杂体积分数复合材料的全尺度仿真与均匀化响应对比完成验证；均匀化模型能在2%误差内重现整体力-位移响应，并再现异质复合材料的损伤演化特征，同时显著降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 该多尺度均匀化+等效超弹性+损伤+混合有限元的框架是颗粒弹性体复合材料结构损伤传播分析的有效且高效工具，兼具精度与效率。

title: Vibrational Dressing of Collective Molecular Polaritons: A Scalable Green's-Function Theory
summary: We develop a scalable Green's-function theory of vibrationally dressed molecular-polariton absorption in the Holstein--Tavis--Cummings model. Within the self-consistent Born approximation (SCBA), the ground-state linear response of $N$ identical molecules coupled to one cavity mode follows from a $2\times2$ cavity--bright matrix, while scattering through the $N-1$ dark states remains in the molecular self-energy. The number of self-consistent equations is independent of $N$, allowing large ensembles to be treated without explicitly resolving the dark manifold. Benchmarks against hierarchical equations of motion show that the theory captures collective linewidth narrowing and an $N$-dependent minimum in the lower-polariton linewidth as its exciton fraction varies, beyond a Hopfield-weighted linewidth estimate. Comparisons with exact diagonalization for discrete local vibrations show weaker vibronic progressions and better overall SCBA agreement as $N$ increases at fixed single-molecule coupling. The resulting framework connects microscopic vibrational scattering to collective absorption spectra without introducing fitted polariton linewidths.

AI.tldr: We present a scalable Green's-function theory (SCBA) for vibrationally dressed molecular-polariton absorption, reducing the N-molecule problem to a 2x2 cavity-bright matrix with dark-state scattering in the self-energy, capturing collective linewidth narrowing and N-dependent lower-polariton linewidth minima.
AI.motivation: Describing vibrationally dressed collective polariton absorption for large molecular ensembles is challenging because explicitly resolving the N-1 dark states scales poorly with N; existing Hopfield-weighted linewidth estimates are insufficient.
AI.method: Develops a Green's-function theory of absorption in the Holstein–Tavis–Cummings model within the self-consistent Born approximation (SCBA). The ground-state linear response of N identical molecules coupled to one cavity mode is formulated via a 2x2 cavity–bright matrix, while scattering through the N-1 dark states is folded into the molecular self-energy, keeping the number of self-consistent equations independent of N.
AI.result: Benchmarked against hierarchical equations of motion, the theory reproduces collective linewidth narrowing and an N-dependent minimum in the lower-polariton linewidth as its exciton fraction varies, beyond a Hopfield-weighted estimate. Against exact diagonalization for discrete local vibrations, it shows weaker vibronic progressions and better SCBA agreement as N grows at fixed single-molecule coupling.
AI.conclusion: The framework links microscopic vibrational scattering to collective absorption spectra without fitted polariton linewidths, enabling scalable treatment of large ensembles.

title: Data-Driven Optimization of Seminumerical Exchange for SIMD CPUs
summary: We present a seminumerical exchange algorithm (SNK) based on the sn-LinK method [Laqua et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 16, 1456 (2020)], optimized for modern multi-core central processing units with single instruction multiple data vector instructions and report its implementation into the Q-Chem quantum chemistry program. Vectorization and memory management strategies for the Boys function and 3-center-1-electron (3c1e) integral kernels are given. Several new considerations are made in the computation of the 3c1e integrals: the Head-Gordon Pople horizontal recurrence relations, same-center optimizations, and multishell optimizations, all implemented symbolically employing the SymPy symbolic algebra library and exported as optimized C++ code leveraging common-sub-expression elimination (CSE) optimization techniques. A general scheme for choosing optimal integral kernels is developed through rigorous timing benchmarks. The resulting implementation is tested against traditional 4c2e exchange for several systems and basis sets, showing 1-2 orders of magnitude speedups for systems of practically relevant sizes (100-500 atoms, 2000-10000 basis functions). For smaller molecules, comparisons are also made against the more efficient occ-RI-K method showing a break-even point around 50-100 atoms beyond which SNK dramatically outperforms due to its superior sub-quadratic (between linear and quadratic) time complexity as well as its effectively negligible memory demand.

AI.tldr: 提出基于sn-LinK的半数值交换算法SNK，经向量化、内存管理与符号化积分核优化后实现于Q-Chem，在数百原子体系上较传统4c2e交换快1-2个数量级，并在50-100原子以上超越occ-RI-K。
AI.motivation: 传统4c2e交换计算昂贵，occ-RI-K虽高效但受内存与二次复杂度限制；需要适配现代多核CPU（SIMD向量指令）的高效交换算法以支撑百至数百原子、数千基函数的实际大体系计算。
AI.method: 在sn-LinK基础上构建SNK算法并实现于Q-Chem。针对Boys函数与3c1e积分核给出向量化与内存管理策略；引入Head-Gordon Pople水平递推关系、同中心与多壳层优化，用SymPy符号推导并以CSE优化导出C++代码；通过严格计时基准建立最优积分核选择方案。
AI.result: 对若干体系与基组，相比传统4c2e交换在100-500原子、2000-10000基函数规模获得1-2个数量级加速；小分子上与occ-RI-K比较，约50-100原子为盈亏平衡点，之后SNK因亚二次（介于线性与二次之间）复杂度及近乎可忽略的内存需求而显著更优。
AI.conclusion: SNK是可扩展、内存友好的半数值交换方案，适合大体系Hartree-Fock/DFT交换计算，符号化代码生成与自动核选择是性能关键。

title: Constrained Nuclear-Electronic Orbital Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory for Excited-State Dynamics with Nuclear Quantum Effects
summary: Nuclear quantum effects can strongly influence excited-state processes involving light nuclei, yet their inclusion in practical molecular dynamics remains challenging. We develop constrained nuclear-electronic orbital time-dependent density functional theory (CNEO-TDDFT), which incorporates quantum-nuclear delocalization into full-dimensional effective excited-state potential energy surfaces while retaining the formal structure and computational scaling of conventional TDDFT. Analytic gradients are also developed, enabling efficient on-the-fly excited-state dynamics. CNEO-TDDFT substantially improves excited-state vibrational frequencies involving hydrogen motion and reduces the root-mean-square deviation from experiment from 113 cm$^{-1}$ to 26 cm$^{-1}$. For excited-state proton transfer in 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline (HBQ), CNEO-TDDFT yields a characteristic transfer time of 14.0 fs, compared with 25.5 fs from conventional TDDFT, consistent with the experimentally inferred ultrafast timescale of 12$\pm$6 fs. These results establish CNEO-TDDFT as an accurate and efficient framework for excited-state dynamics with nuclear quantum effects.

AI.tldr: 提出CNEO-TDDFT方法，将核量子离域效应纳入全维激发态势能面，保持常规TDDFT的计算标度，并开发解析梯度用于高效非绝热动力学模拟。
AI.motivation: 核量子效应显著影响含轻核的激发态过程，但难以在实际分子动力学中纳入。
AI.method: 约束核电子轨道含时密度泛函理论（CNEO-TDDFT）：在全维有效激发态势能面中引入核的量子离域，保留TDDFT形式结构与计算标度；并推导解析梯度，实现高效on-the-fly激发态动力学。
AI.result: 含氢振动激发态频率明显改善，与实验的RMSD由113 cm⁻¹降至26 cm⁻¹；HBQ激发态质子转移特征时间由常规TDDFT的25.5 fs变为14.0 fs，与实验推断的12±6 fs一致。
AI.conclusion: CNEO-TDDFT是准确高效的含核量子效应激发态动力学框架。

title: Energy Flow Shapes the Decomposition Dynamics of a Reactive Atmospheric Intermediate
summary: The unimolecular dynamics of Criegee intermediates depend strongly on their internal energy, which can differ substantially between nascent atmospheric species and laboratory-prepared reactants. Here, the decomposition dynamics of {\it anti-}CH$_3$CHOO are investigated using molecular dynamics simulations on a neural network-based potential energy surface under thermal and mode-selective vibrational excitation. Simulations were performed at internal energies representative of those released during ozonolysis (chemical/thermal preparation, TP) or following vibrational excitation (VibEx) along the CH-stretching mode with two or three quanta, as can be done in laboratory studies. These excitation conditions strongly affect reaction yields and kinetics, with VibEx promoting passage across the initial cyclization barrier. For TP, 35 kcal/mol of internal energy are required to form molecular products, whereas for VibEx, 27 kcal/mol are sufficient. Although TP and VibEx ensembles access largely the same fragmentation pathways with comparable relative yields, the absolute product yields, characteristic timescales, and kinetic behavior differ substantially. Methyldioxirane is found to be a kinetic trap along the pathway. The resulting molecular-level description of {\it anti-}CH$_3$CHOO decomposition provides guidance for interpreting experiments and contributes to a broader understanding of energy-dependent Criegee-intermediate dynamics.

AI.tldr: 利用神经网络势能面的分子动力学模拟，比较了热/化学制备与模式选择性振动激发下anti-CH3CHOO的单分子分解动力学，发现激发方式显著改变产物产率、时间尺度与动力学行为。
AI.motivation: Criegee中间体的单分子动力学强烈依赖内能，而大气中新生物种与实验室制备反应物的内能差异很大，因此需要厘清能量来源与激发方式如何影响其分解。
AI.method: 在神经网络势能面上对anti-CH3CHOO进行分子动力学模拟，设置两类初始条件：代表臭氧分解释能的化学/热制备（TP），以及沿CH伸缩模加2或3个量子的模式选择性振动激发（VibEx）。
AI.result: 激发条件强烈影响反应产率与动力学：VibEx促进跨越初始环化势垒；TP需约35 kcal/mol内能才能生成分子产物，而VibEx仅需约27 kcal/mol。两者可及的碎裂通道与相对产率相近，但绝对产率、特征时间尺度与动力学行为差异明显；methyldioxirane是路径上的动力学陷阱。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出anti-CH3CHOO分解的分子层面图像，有助于解释实验并加深对能量依赖的Criegee中间体动力学理解。

title: From Algebraic Completeness to Orbit Separation: Recursive Separating Invariants for Global Neural Network Potential Energy Surfaces
comment: 30 pages, plus 37 pages of Supporting Information appended
summary: Permutationally invariant polynomials (PIPs) provide a systematically improvable, symmetry-preserving representation for global potential energy surfaces (PESs), but their high computational cost as neural network descriptors limits applications to large molecular systems. Fundamental invariants (FIs), which form an algebraically complete generating set, substantially reduce the number of descriptors and enable neural network PESs for larger systems. However, PES evaluation remains computationally expensive as molecular size and complexity increase. Here, we introduce recursive separating invariants (RSIs), shifting the descriptor design principle from algebraic completeness to orbit separation. RSIs are constructed systematically through correlation order and recursion depth, providing a more computationally efficient representation. Benchmarks on reactive and nonreactive systems demonstrate that RSI-based neural network (RSI-NN) PESs achieve approximately an order-of-magnitude faster evaluation than their FI-NN counterparts, with system-dependent prediction accuracy that is comparable in several cases. These results establish orbit separation as a promising principle for developing efficient symmetry-preserving descriptors for global neural network PESs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出递归分离不变量（RSI），将描述符设计原则从"代数完备性"转向"轨道分离"，从而构建更高效、对称性保持的神经网络势能面描述符。
AI.motivation: PIP描述符计算代价高，难以用于大体系；FI虽为代数完备生成集、能减少描述符数量，但随分子规模和复杂度增加，PES评估仍然昂贵。
AI.method: 提出递归分离不变量（RSI），以轨道分离（orbit separation）代替代数完备性作为设计原则，通过相关阶（correlation order）与递归深度系统构建描述符，并据此训练RSI-NN势能面模型。
AI.result: 在反应性与非反应性体系上，RSI-NN势能面的评估速度比FI-NN快约一个数量级，预测精度在不同体系下有所差异，但若干情形下相当。
AI.conclusion: 轨道分离可作为开发高效、对称性保持描述符的有效原则，适用于全局神经网络势能面。

title: Correlation between normal character and Raman intensities of isotopologues of carbon dioxide
summary: Previous studies on the vibrational structure of carbon dioxide isotopologues have revealed a correlation between the strength of Fermi interactions and a recently defined normal-mode parameter. In this contribution, we investigate how the Raman intensities of the most intense bands evolve across the complete series of carbon dioxide isotopologues at room temperature. To this end, we introduce a general scheme for simulating Raman intensities in linear triatomic molecules, based on the computation of the mean polarizability surface up to cubic terms for all twelve stable species. For the first time, we establish correlations between the degree of normality and the Raman transition intensities, mean polarizability derivatives, and variational Raman shift errors across the CO$_2$ isotopologue series. The observed trends are further analyzed by considering rotational contributions, which may partially account for the deviations observed in the correlations. Our study is supported by experimental Raman spectra of isotopically enriched samples and theoretical simulations. Although this study focuses on carbon dioxide, similar behavior is expected for other series of isotopologues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出线性三原子分子拉曼强度模拟通用方案，首次在全部12种稳定CO₂同位素体中建立"正则程度"与拉曼跃迁强度、平均极化率导数及变分拉曼位移误差之间的相关性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现CO₂同位素体振动结构中费米相互作用强度与一个新定义的正则模式参数相关，但拉曼强度在同位素体系中的演化规律尚不清楚，需要系统研究。
AI.method: 建立基于平均极化率面（计算至三次项）的线性三原子分子拉曼强度模拟方案，对全部12种稳定CO₂同位素体计算；结合同位素富集样品的实验拉曼光谱与理论模拟，并考虑转动贡献分析偏差。
AI.result: 首次揭示正则程度与拉曼跃迁强度、平均极化率导数、变分拉曼位移误差之间存在相关性趋势；转动贡献可部分解释相关性中的偏离。
AI.conclusion: CO₂同位素体系呈现可解释的拉曼强度演化规律，该方案可推广至其他同位素体系。

title: Hierarchical universal open structure dataset for atomistic modeling
summary: Atomic-scale simulations have been transformed by machine-learning models that predict the properties of atomistic structures with the accuracy of quantum calculations, but at a small fraction of the cost. These models have increased dramatically in generality, thanks to the availability of synthetic datasets of ever-increasing size and scope. The proliferation of datasets, with properties often computed using different levels of electronic-structure approximation, is problematic, as there is often overlap between different datasets, and strong correlations between structures obtained with short molecular dynamics trajectories or geometry optimization. To address these problems, we introduce a protocol to stratify a dataset into a hierarchy of nested subsets, subsampling from the coarsest to the finest resolution based on an "ecumetric" built to reflect the latent space representation of several popular universal machine-learning interatomic potentials. We then use this approach to combine most of the open structural datasets currently available, consolidating them into MAD-COSMO, a well-organized collection of almost 1.7 billion structures, whose $2^{24}$ most diverse members form the MAD-CORE stratified coreset, which can be easily used for all sorts of tasks, from exploratory experiments to the training of foundation models at scale. We envision that this collection will guide and help coordinate future efforts, focusing them on the most relevant and/or undersampled regions of chemical and structural space, and that it will be further extended to incorporate the outcomes of the collective work of this community.

AI.tldr: 作者提出一种"生态度量(ecumetric)"分层采样协议,将现有开放原子结构数据集整合为约17亿结构的MAD-COSMO,并抽取2^24个最多样结构构成MAD-CORE核心子集。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势依赖日益庞大且重叠的合成数据集,但不同数据集采用不同电子结构近似精度,且由短分子动力学轨迹或几何优化得到的结构高度相关,导致冗余与偏差,影响训练数据质量。
AI.method: 基于若干主流通用机器学习原子间势的潜空间表示构建"ecumetric"度量,按由粗到细的分辨率逐层嵌套子采样,实现数据集分层(stratification);并据此合并当前可获取的大部分开放结构数据集。
AI.result: 构建了MAD-COSMO,一个组织良好的、含近1.7亿(1.7 billion)结构的集合,其2^24个最具多样性的成员组成MAD-CORE分层核心集,可直接用于探索性实验乃至规模化基础模型训练。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集有望引导和协调未来工作,聚焦化学与结构空间中最重要的及采样不足的区域,并由社区共同工作持续扩展。

title: Vertical ionization energies from inverse generalized Kohn-Sham calculations at fixed electron density
summary: The exact Kohn--Sham (KS) system must have its highest occupied orbital energy equal to the negative of the lowest vertical ionization energy (VIE). No comparable theorem connects the deeper occupied levels $\varepsilon_k$ to the higher VIEs $I_k$. Chong, Gritsenko and Baerends (CGB) established empirically that $I_k + \varepsilon_k\propto\sqrt{\varepsilon_{\mathrm{HOMO}}-\varepsilon_k}$. We ask whether a similar relation holds for the exact generalized Kohn-Sham (GKS) system, which incorporates a fraction $α$ of Hartree-Fock exchange. We invert near-exact CCSD/aug-cc-pVQZ ground-state densities of LiH, LiF, H$_2$O, HF, CO, N$_2$ and F$_2$ at $α= 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0$ and obtain the exact GKS systems at each admixture. As the density is held fixed and only the operator is varied, the resulting occupied spectra separate the effect of exact-exchange admixture on orbital energies from its effect on the density, two contributions inseparable in a self-consistent hybrid calculation. The CGB relation holds broadly across the family, with a proportionality coefficient linear in $α$, $c(α)=c(0)-sα$, where $c(0)=1.185\pm0.017$ eV$^{1/2}$ and $s=1.987\pm0.041$ eV$^{1/2}$, with $R^{2}\ge0.9996$ for H$_2$O, CO, HF and N$_2$. Using the response-potential matrix elements tabulated by Gritsenko, Braïda and Baerends, we decompose the CGB coefficient into response and spectroscopic parts, and find $s$ to agree with the homogeneous-electron-gas step-height coefficient $K_g = 1.9932$ eV$^{1/2}$, which we conjecture is its origin. The coefficient vanishes at $α^{*}=0.597\pm0.008$. At $α^{*}$ the HOMO-referenced GKS occupied levels satisfy $\varepsilon_k\approx-I_k$ across the whole occupied range. The zero crossing is fixed by the core orbitals; in the outer valence the CGB coefficient is already indistinguishable from zero at $α=0$.

AI.tldr: 通过在固定密度下反演近精确密度得到的广义Kohn-Sham (GKS) 系统,作者证明CGB关联仍然成立,其比例系数随精确交换分数α线性下降,并在α*≈0.597处为零,此时占据轨道能近似等于负的电离能。
AI.motivation: 精确KS理论只保证HOMO能量等于最低垂直电离能的负值,而对更深占据能级与更高电离能之间缺乏定理。CGB曾经验性地提出I_k+ε_k与√(ε_HOMO−ε_k)成正比,但该关系是否也适用于含精确交换的GKS系统,以及精确交换如何影响轨道能尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对LiH、LiF、H2O、HF、CO、N2、F2,用CCSD/aug-cc-pVQZ近精确基态密度,在α=0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0下通过密度反演获得精确GKS系统。固定密度只改变算符,从而将精确交换杂化对轨道能的影响与对密度的影响分离。再利用Gritsenko、Braïda和Baerends给出的响应势矩阵元,把CGB系数分解为响应项与谱学项。
AI.result: CGB关系在全系列分子中普遍成立,比例系数随α线性变化:c(α)=c(0)−sα,其中c(0)=1.185±0.017 eV^{1/2},s=1.987±0.041 eV^{1/2};对H2O、CO、HF、N2的R²≥0.9996。s与均匀电子气台阶高度系数K_g=1.9932 eV^{1/2}一致,作者推测后者即其来源。系数在α*=0.597±0.008处消失,在该α*下HOMO参考的GKS占据能级在整个占据范围内近似满足ε_k≈−I_k。过零点由核心轨道决定;在外价区,α=0时CGB系数已与零不可区分。
AI.conclusion: CGB经验关系在精确GKS系统中普遍成立,并可解析地分解为响应与谱学两部分,其斜率来源于均匀电子气台阶高度系数。通过调节精确交换分数α,可使GKS占据轨道能在整个占据范围内近似等于负电离能,零交叉点α*≈0.6,且由核心轨道而非外价轨道决定。

authors: Floris F. S. van der Tak
title: Rovibrational cross sections for the CO$_2$ $00^00$, $01^10$, $02^20$ and Fermi resonance states $10^00(1)$ and $10^00(2)$ in collisions with He atoms
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for publication
summary: We present quantum scattering calculations of CO$_2$-He state-to-state integral cross sections for 25 transition sets, covering pure rotational transitions within and rovibrational transitions between: the ground state $00^00$, the bend fundamental $01^10$, the bending overtone $02^20$, and the Fermi doublet states $10^00(1)$ and $10^00(2)$. Exact coupled-channel (CC) and coupled-states approximation (CSA) calculations are performed using a new five-dimensional potential energy surface. The calculations cover collision energies from 20 to 5220 cm$^{-1}$, sufficient to obtain converged rate coefficients over 100-800 K, and include initial rotational states for each transition up to at least $j=35$. We present an energy-grid algorithm for rovibrational quantum scattering calculations that minimizes the number of separate calculations required. The resulting cross sections exhibit a dominant $Δj=0$ propensity and parity-dependent patterns. For the benchmark $00^00,j' \leftarrow 01^10,j$ transition, thermally averaged rate coefficients reproduce available experimental data. A comparison between the CC and CSA cross sections shows that, for vibrational quenching transitions, the CSA cross sections increasingly deviate from the CC results with increasing initial rotational state $j$. Calculated integral cross sections cover collision energies and rotational states needed to derive rate coefficients for non local thermal equilibrium radiative transfer modeling of mid-infrared CO$_2$ spectra. The computationally simpler CO$_2$-He system allows the methodology and approximations to be tested at high collision energies and rotational states, helping assess their suitability for the more complex and astrochemically important CO$_2$-H$_2$ system.

AI.tldr: 本文用量子散射方法计算了CO₂-He在25组跃迁（转动与振转）上的态-态积分截面，涵盖20–5220 cm⁻¹碰撞能与100–800 K速率系数，并给出最小化计算量的能量网格算法及CC与CSA的对比。
AI.motivation: 需为CO₂中红外光谱的非局部热平衡辐射转移建模提供速率系数，并检验近似方法在高温、高转动激发下的适用性，为更复杂的CO₂-H₂体系做方法学准备。
AI.method: 基于新的五维势能面，对基态、弯曲基频、弯曲泛频及Fermi双线态间的25组跃迁进行精确耦合通道(CC)与耦合态近似(CSA)计算；初始转动态至少覆盖至j=35；提出一种减少独立计算次数的能量网格算法。
AI.result: 截面呈现主导的Δj=0倾向与宇称相关规律；基准跃迁00⁰0,j′←01¹0,j的热平均速率系数与实验数据吻合；对于振动淬灭跃迁，CSA随初始j增大而愈发偏离CC结果。
AI.conclusion: 计算结果覆盖非局部热平衡辐射转移建模所需的能量与转动范围，可作为方法学测试平台，评估近似方法用于CO₂-H₂体系的适用性。

title: Simulated Solvation Dynamics of a Photoexcited Organic Molecule and the Associated Time-Resolved X-ray Scattering Signal
summary: Solvation shell reorganization is a key component of the dynamics after photoexcitation of a solvated molecule, especially for charge-transfer excitation in polar solvents. These structural dynamics can be directly observed with time-resolved X-ray solution scattering (TR-XSS) experiments. However, disentangling the scattering signal of solvation-shell reorganization can be challenging, especially for systems containing only light atoms. Here, nonequilibrium molecular dynamics simulations of a hemithioindigo chromophore in acetonitrile are used to investigate the solvation dynamics upon photoinduced charge transfer as well as vibrational excitation and cooling, and to characterize the corresponding time-resolved X-ray scattering signals. It is found that charge transfer induces rapid reorientation of the first solvation shell (0.15-0.2 ps) followed by slower reorientational and solvent redistribution within and between shells (1-2 ps). An analysis of the volume around the solute excluded to the solvent reveals an initial contraction of the solvation shell, followed by transient rebound within the first 0.4 ps, and then slower contraction. Instantaneous vibrational excitation expands the excluded volume, reaching a maximum near 0.4 ps, followed by contraction during cooling with biexponential relaxation. Low-q features in both the calculated solute-solvent and solvent-solvent scattering signals reflect rearrangements within the first solvation shell and redistribution across shells, while higher-q solute-solvent features more closely follow local first-shell restructuring. These results show that TR-XSS can provide information on both local solvent rearrangements and redistribution across solvation shells and demonstrate that interpreting the scattering signals requires accounting for changes in solvent packing induced by vibrational heating and cooling of the solute.

AI.tldr: 通过非平衡分子动力学模拟研究半硫靛染料在乙腈中光致电荷转移后的溶剂化壳重组，并刻画对应的TR-XSS散射信号特征。
AI.motivation: 溶剂化壳重组是电荷转移激发后的关键动力学过程，TR-XSS可直接观测，但尤其对仅含轻原子的体系，溶剂壳重组的散射信号难以与其它信号区分，因此需要理论模拟加以解析。
AI.method: 对半硫靛发色团在乙腈中的体系进行非平衡分子动力学模拟，考察光致电荷转移及振动激发与冷却过程，计算并分析时间分辨X射线散射信号（溶质-溶剂与溶剂-溶剂分量，区分低q与高q特征），并结合溶质周围排除体积分析。
AI.result: 电荷转移引发第一溶剂化壳的快速重取向（0.15–0.2 ps），随后是较慢的重取向与壳内/壳间溶剂再分布（1–2 ps）；排除体积先收缩、0.4 ps内出现瞬态回弹再缓慢收缩；振动激发使排除体积膨胀并在约0.4 ps达峰，冷却阶段以双指数方式收缩。低q特征反映第一壳重组与跨壳再分布，高q溶质-溶剂特征更贴近局部第一壳重构。
AI.conclusion: TR-XSS可同时提供局部溶剂重组与跨溶剂壳再分布的信息，但解读散射信号必须考虑溶质振动加热与冷却引起的溶剂堆积变化。

title: Learning the information contained in the microstructure of data distributions
summary: Understanding how much and where information is nested in sets of data obtained using different parameters and metrics is a typical problem in the analysis of high-dimensional datasets. Approaches based on relative data-driven metrics may be poorly quantitative and difficult to interpret, while accurate methods may be computationally expensive and impractical for large datasets. Here, we report an efficient, quantitative, and transferable method useful to this end, which we call "Micro-Information Analysis". Its foundation is based on the tight relationship that exists between the microscopic features of data distributions and the information they contain. The method performs preliminary unsupervised clustering, capturing microstructural features of data distributions such as the dominant Gaussian microdomains (microstates) present in them, their population, separation, and their residual non-Gaussian fraction. Leveraging the principle of clustering-and-minimization of Shannon entropy, this allows quantifying in bit (that is, in absolute metric) the information contained in the microstructure of the data, and how much information is nested in each Gaussian and non-Gaussian microdomain. The output of the analysis is a set of easily interpretable Information-Microstructure plots that allow to readily compare and rank data based on their information content and to graphically map the information breakdown among their various microenvironments in diagrams that are easy to interpret. We prove the efficiency of our method by analyzing and ranking data generated synthetically or from molecular simulations, demonstrating how "Micro-Information Analysis" is a physically-grounded quantitative tool useful for the study of physical systems from their data and for data science in general.

AI.tldr: 提出"微信息分析"(Micro-Information Analysis)方法，通过无监督聚类捕获数据分布的微观结构（高斯微域/微态及其占比、分离度、非高斯残余），结合聚类与香农熵最小化原理，以比特为单位定量数据微观结构所含信息及其在各微域中的嵌套分布。
AI.motivation: 高维数据分析中，需理解信息在不同参数与度量下的数据集中"有多少、在哪里"嵌套。相对性数据驱动指标缺乏定量性且难解释，精确方法计算昂贵、难以用于大数据集，因此需要一种高效、定量且可迁移的方法。
AI.method: 以数据分布微观特征与其信息量的紧密关系为基础：先做无监督聚类，捕获主导高斯微域（微态）、其群体、分离度以及残余非高斯比例；再基于"聚类—香农熵最小化"原理，以比特（绝对度量）量化微观结构信息及每个高斯/非高斯微域中嵌套的信息；输出易于解释的"信息-微观结构"图，可比较排序数据并图形化映射信息分解。
AI.result: 通过对合成数据及分子模拟数据的分析与排序，验证了方法效率，表明"微信息分析"是从数据研究物理系统及通用数据科学中有物理依据的定量工具。
AI.conclusion: "微信息分析"提供了一种高效、定量、可迁移的信息量化框架，输出直观可解释的图表，适用于物理系统研究与一般数据分析场景。

title: Adding Temperature to the Adiabatic Connection: Hybrid Functionals for Static and Dynamic Correlation
summary: Capturing static and dynamic electron correlation simultaneously at manageable computational cost remains a key challenge in electronic structure theory. Motivated by the recurring role of effective temperature in self-consistent field methods we extend the adiabatic connection mechanism from density functional theory to include a temperature dimension. This gives rise to thermally enhanced hybrid functionals, in which static correlation is captured via fractional occupations generated by an effective "correlation temperature" within thermal Hartree-Fock, while dynamic correlation is described by established density functional approximations. The framework formally unifies information-density matrix functional theory (i-DMFT) and thermally-assisted-occupation (TAO-)DFT as special cases, clarifying their theoretical basis and the respective prescriptions for the temperature parameter. We assess the performance of several thermally enhanced hybrids for different cases where i-DMFT was previously shown to fail. Furthermore, we discuss and test different schemes for determining the correlation temperature and investigate the accuracy of different such choices for a benchmark set derived from biphenyl. The results help to clarify the achievable balance of accuracy, generality, and efficiency, establishing thermally enhanced hybrids as a systematic route toward low-cost treatment of both correlation types.

AI.tldr: 将DFT绝热连接机制扩展到温度维度，提出"热增强杂化泛函"：用热Hartree-Fock的有效相关温度产生分数占据以描述静态相关，用常规密度泛函描述动态相关，并统一了i-DMFT与TAO-DFT。
AI.motivation: 同时、低成本地捕捉静态与动态电子相关是电子结构理论的长期难题，且现有i-DMFT方法在部分情形下失效，其温度参数缺乏统一理论依据。
AI.method: 在绝热连接中引入温度维度，构建热增强杂化泛函；理论上证明i-DMFT与TAO-DFT为本框架特例；在i-DMFT曾失效的案例上评测多种热增强杂化泛函，并比较不同相关温度确定方案在联苯基准集上的精度。
AI.result: 明确了i-DMFT与TAO-DFT的理论关系及温度参数设定方式；在i-DMFT失效案例上评估了热增强杂化泛函表现，并在联苯基准集上量化了不同相关温度选择方案的精度差异。
AI.conclusion: 热增强杂化泛函为兼顾精度、普适性与效率提供了系统化路径，可作为低成本同时处理两类电子相关的可行方案。

title: AeroProp-X: An Open-Source, Self-Verifying Method-of-Characteristics Toolkit for Edge-Capable Rocket Nozzle Design and Aerothermodynamic Analysis
summary: The design of supersonic rocket nozzles by the Method of Characteristics is a mature discipline, yet the software that implements it is frequently either proprietary, heavyweight, or opaque, which limits reproducibility and classroom and field use. This paper presents AeroProp-X, an open-source, dependency-light toolkit that synthesizes shock-free minimum-length nozzle contours and evaluates their ideal aerothermodynamic performance entirely on commodity hardware without graphics acceleration or network access. The central contribution is methodological rather than physical: the planar characteristics solver is made self-verifying by exploiting an exact gas-dynamic invariant, namely that the computed exit wall height ratio must equal the isentropic area ratio at the design Mach number, so that every generated contour reports its own discretization error automatically. We describe the governing theory, the layered software architecture, and the synthesis algorithm, and we validate the implementation against analytic compressible-flow tables and against the expansion ratios of historical flight engines. The solver reproduces tabulated gas-dynamic quantities to table precision and converges to the exact area ratio with relative error below three parts in ten thousand, while remaining small enough to run interactively on an embedded-class processor. We argue that built-in verifiability, dependency minimalism, and explicit scoping of the ideal-flow assumptions together make the tool well suited to education, preliminary design, and reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 提出开源轻量工具 AeroProp-X，用特征线法生成无激波最短喷管型面并因其内置自校验机制而具备可复现优势。
AI.motivation: 现有实现特征线法设计超声速喷管的软件多为专有、庞大或不透明，妨碍可复现性与教学/现场使用。
AI.method: 基于平面特征线求解器构建分层架构工具，利用"出口壁高比须等于设计马赫数等熵面积比"这一精确气体动力学不变量实现自动离散误差报告（自校验），并给出控制方程、软件架构与合成算法。
AI.result: 与解析可压缩流表及历史飞行发动机膨胀比对照，可复现表格精度的气动量，面积比相对误差低于万分之三，且可在嵌入式级处理器上交互运行。
AI.conclusion: 内置可验证性、依赖极简及对理想流假设的明确界定，使该工具适用于教学、初步设计与可复现研究。

title: Physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (PIKANs) for noise-robust reconstruction of boiling heat flux from infrared measurements
summary: Recovering a noise-amplified inverse quantity from corrupted boundary data is a recurring problem in physics-informed learning for real-world applications. Specifically, small perturbations in the measured field are magnified through the spatial derivatives needed to reconstruct the target, and hence conventional discretization solvers turn them into large unphysical oscillations. We study this problem through the reconstruction of local time-resolved nucleate-boiling heat flux, which cannot be measured directly and must be inferred from infrared surface temperatures by solving an unsteady three-dimensional heat-conduction problem with sharp and rapidly evolving liquid-vapor interface gradients. We show that neither network architecture nor optimizer alone overcomes the spectral bias that smooths away these interface-scale features, and that the two must be addressed jointly. Our approach combines a Chebyshev physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold network (PIKAN) backbone, a quasi-second-order (SOAP) optimizer, and a temperature-annealed residual-based resampling scheme that concentrates collocation points at high-residual interface regions. Trained directly on experimental infrared measurements imposed as a boundary condition, the network resolves high-frequency bubble signatures and the high-flux distribution tail much better than a Fourier-feature PINN of equal size and training budget. In particular, it selectively filters measurement noise while preserving the physically meaningful high-frequency features, suppressing the spurious oscillations that contaminate finite-volume reconstructions and yielding more physically consistent heat-flux estimates from noisy experimental data.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究从含噪红外表面温度数据反演局部时间分辨核态沸腾热流，提出将切比雪夫PIKAN骨干、SOAP优化器与温度退火残差重采样联合使用的框架，显著优于同等规模Fourier特征PINN。
AI.motivation: 从受污染的边界数据恢复噪声放大的反演量是物理信息学习在真实应用中的常见难题：求解所需的空间导数会放大测量场的微小扰动，使传统离散化求解器产生大量非物理振荡。本文以核态沸腾局部时间分辨热流重建为例，该量无法直接测量，只能由红外表面温度求解非定常三维热传导反问题得到，其液-汽界面梯度尖锐且快速演化。
AI.method: 作者指出单靠网络结构或优化器都无法克服抹平界面尺度特征的谱偏置，需二者联合处理。方法包含三部分：切比雪夫物理信息Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（PIKAN）骨干、准二阶SOAP优化器，以及基于残差的温度退火重采样策略——将配点集中到高残差的界面区域。网络直接以实验红外测量作为边界条件训练。
AI.result: 在相同规模和训练预算下，该方法比Fourier特征PINN更好地解析高频气泡特征与高热流分布尾部；它能选择性滤除测量噪声同时保留物理有意义的高频特征，抑制污染有限体积重建的虚假振荡，从含噪实验数据中得到物理更一致的热流估计。
AI.conclusion: 结论：网络架构与优化器必须联合设计才能缓解谱偏置；切比雪夫PIKAN+SOAP+退火重采样的组合为噪声放大反问题提供了一种兼顾去噪与保留界面尺度特征的可行方案。

title: Iterative Neural Variational Solver of Committor Function in Under-damped Langevin Dynamics
summary: The committor function describes the probability that a stochastic dynamical system, while transitioning between two metastable states, will first reach one state rather than the other. It is a central object in transition path theory, providing the accurate reaction rate and the characterization of the transition mechanism through reactive probability flux and the transition state ensemble. While the numerical methods for this function are well studied for over-damped Langevin dynamics where the friction damping coefficient goes to infinity, its computation in the general under-damped case remains an open challenge due to the lack of a variational structure in the underlying backward Kolmogorov equation. This restricts the quantitative investigation of the impact of the finite damping coefficient on rare transitions in real systems. In this work, by decomposing the infinitesimal generator of the underdamped Langevin dynamics into a self-adjoint and a skew-adjoint part, we develop an iterative scheme in which each subproblem has a variational form and can be solved efficiently using neural networks. Fundamentally, this approach can be viewed as a generalized Concus-Golub-Widlund (CGW) splitting method and each subproblem has a variational form, which can be solved efficiently. This iterative scheme also has the flexibility of introducing a preconditioning operator associated with a new overdamped Langevin dynamics, which naturally leads to the design of enhanced adaptive sampling for the subproblems.
