We validate the efficiency and accuracy of our method on benchmark systems including a one-dimensional double-well potential, the Muller-Brown potential, and alanine dipeptide. The proposed iterative variational framework provides a practical and extensible numerical tool for probing rare transition events in Langevin dynamics across varying damping coefficients.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将欠阻尼Langevin动力学生成元分解为自伴与反自伴部分，构造可神经网络求解的迭代变分格式（广义CGW分裂），以计算有限阻尼下的committor函数。
AI.motivation: 过阻尼Langevin下committor函数数值方法已成熟，但一般欠阻尼情形的后向Kolmogorov方程缺乏变分结构，计算仍是开放问题，限制了有限阻尼系数对稀有跃迁影响的研究。
AI.method: 把欠阻尼Langevin动力学的无穷小生成元拆成自伴与反自伴两部分，设计迭代格式使每个子问题都具有变分形式并用神经网络高效求解；该方法可视为广义Concus-Golub-Widlund (CGW)分裂。进一步引入与新过阻尼Langevin动力学相关的前处理算子，并为子问题设计增强自适应采样。
AI.result: 在一维双势阱、Muller-Brown势和丙氨酸二肽等基准系统上验证了方法的效率与精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提迭代变分框架为探究不同阻尼系数下Langevin动力学稀有跃迁事件提供了实用且可扩展的数值工具。

title: pcNN-SN: a physics-enhanced predictor-corrector neural network algorithm coupled with the discrete ordinates method for neutron transport equations
summary: Super-resolution machine learning methods hold promise for addressing the high computational costs associated with high-dimensional features in traditional transport simulations. This paper proposes a physics-enhanced neural network coupling algorithm for discrete ordinates (SN) transport calculations. Based on high- and low-accuracy data, we develop a predictor-corrector neural network (pcNN) to predict correction factors for coarse-grid solutions. Based on transport equations, local physical features containing subgrid-scale information are selected as network inputs. Dimensionless transformation of physical quantities reduces the input space dimensionality and narrows parameter distributions, facilitating network training. Physical constraints are incorporated into the network model, and the corrected solution retains its original conservation properties. pcNN and SN transport sweeps are internally coupled, and numerical solutions are corrected online. Numerical results demonstrate that this algorithm can effectively improve coarse-grid solutions to achieve a level of accuracy comparable to that of fine-grid results. The physics-based network design enables the model to demonstrate a certain degree of reusability under different computational conditions. Compared to mesh refinement, the pcNN-SN algorithm reduces the computation time for the three-dimensional test problem by more than 60%.

AI.tldr: 提出物理增强的predictor-corrector神经网络(pcNN)与离散纵标(SN)输运计算在线耦合算法，用高/低精度数据预测粗网格解的修正因子，将粗网格结果提升至细网格精度，三维算例提速60%以上。
AI.motivation: 传统输运模拟处理高维特征计算成本高，超分辨率机器学习方法有望缓解，但需要既保证物理守恒又具备可复用性的高效方案。
AI.method: 基于高精度与低精度数据训练pcNN预测粗网格解修正因子；从输运方程中选取含亚网格尺度信息的局部物理特征作为输入；采用无量纲变换降低输入维度、收窄参数分布；在网络中嵌入物理约束，使修正解保持原有守恒性；pcNN与SN输运扫描内耦合，在线修正数值解。
AI.result: 有效将粗网格解精度提升至接近细网格结果；基于物理的网络设计使其在不同计算条件下具有一定可复用性；相比网格细化，三维测试问题计算时间减少60%以上。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束+无量纲特征+在线耦合的pcNN-SN框架能在保持守恒性的前提下显著加速SN输运计算，为高维输运模拟提供了可行的超分辨率加速途径。

title: Representation-split Carleman lattice Boltzmann with near-unit step success probability on quantum computers
summary: The Carleman lattice Boltzmann method replaces the quadratic collision of the lattice Boltzmann equation by a linear map on a lifted state. Existing block encodings of this map succeed with probability $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$ per step, so that the probability of a multi-step evolution decays exponentially with the number of steps. This study develops multi-relaxation-time Carleman lattice Boltzmann, a representation split in which the Carleman-lifted collision is performed in a moment basis on the amplitude-encoded state, while streaming remains a permutation in population space. The level-2 hierarchy closes under collision but not under streaming, which generates the work of pressure, advection and stress on the momentum flux. The state therefore remains the full pair array, and the moment representation is an orthogonal change of basis of the population one, with identical dynamics and truncation error. The operator to be block encoded changes with the basis, and with it the success probability of a quantum step. In the weighted Hermite basis with the amplitude encoding $f_i/\sqrt{w_i}$, the relaxation is a diagonal operator of norm one, and the level-2 collision stage becomes this diagonal plus a sparse coupling from products of conserved moments. A structured block encoding of this form raises the single-step success probability on the D2Q9 lattice from $10^{-2}$ for the best population encoding to 0.98. With the pair sector in relative coordinates and scaled, one step requires $O(\log^2 N)$ Toffoli gates and is verified by statevector simulation. The encoding and readout overhead of a $T$-step run is then polynomial in $T$ and $N$ rather than accumulating a factor $p^T$. For resolved flows, the remaining exponential loss in coherent multi-step Carleman lattice Boltzmann evolution is set by the non-equilibrium norm relaxed by dissipation rather than by the block encoding.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出多松弛时间Carleman格子Boltzmann方法，通过在加权Hermite基与幅度编码下使碰撞成为对角算子并配合结构化块编码，将D2Q9单步成功概率从10^-2提升到0.98，且单步仅需O(log^2 N)个Toffoli门。
AI.motivation: 现有Carleman格子Boltzmann方法的块编码单步成功概率极低（10^-5至10^-2），导致多步演化概率随步数指数衰减，限制了量子求解器在流体模拟中的实用性。作者希望找到一种表示变换，使待块编码的算子更易高效编码，从而提升单步成功概率。
AI.method: 提出多松弛时间Carleman格子Boltzmann表示：将Carleman提升后的碰撞放在矩基（moment basis）上对幅度编码态执行，而streaming保持为population空间中的置换。指出level-2层级在碰撞下封闭但streaming下不封闭，产生压力、对流与应力对动量通量的贡献，故状态仍为完整pair数组，矩表示只是population基的正交变换，动力学与截断误差相同。在加权Hermite基配合幅度编码f_i/√w_i下，松弛为范数1的对角算子，level-2碰撞阶段为该对角算子加上守恒矩乘积产生的稀疏耦合，据此构造结构化块编码，并将pair扇区用相对坐标缩放。
AI.result: D2Q9格子上单步成功概率由最佳population编码的10^-2提升至0.98；单步需O(log^2 N)个Toffoli门，并已通过statevector仿真验证。T步运行的编码与读取开销对T和N为多项式，而不再累积p^T因子。对于可解析流动，相干多步演化中残余的指数损失由耗散所松弛的非平衡范数决定，而非块编码决定。
AI.conclusion: 基变换（population→加权Hermite矩基）配合幅度编码可显著改善Carleman LBM的量子块编码效率，把多步演化的指数衰减根源从编码概率转移到物理耗散，为相干多步量子流体模拟提供了可行路径。

title: On the Assessment of Domain Decomposition Approaches in Extended Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the Shock-Dominated Burgers Equation
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures. Numerical study of XPINN domain decomposition strategies for the viscous Burgers equation
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving partial differential equations but often struggle with sharp gradients and shock-dominated solutions. Extended Physics-Informed Neural Networks (XPINNs) address this challenge through domain decomposition; however, the effects of decomposition design, overlap, and local network capacity on solution accuracy remain insufficiently characterized. This work presents a systematic assessment of domain decomposition configurations for XPINNs applied to the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation ($ν=0.01/π$). We compare a standard PINN, a conventional XPINN, a shock-focused XPINN with increased network capacity in the shock-containing subdomain, and overlapping XPINNs with different overlap widths. All configurations are trained using a common protocol based on Adam, L-BFGS refinement, and ten Residual-based Adaptive Refinement (RAR) cycles. Performance is evaluated against a reference solution using global and shock-region relative $L_2$ and $L_\infty$ errors, maximum PDE residuals, and interface continuity errors. The results show that decomposition design strongly affects XPINN accuracy and shock resolution. Among the overlapping configurations, the smallest overlap provides the best accuracy, while larger overlaps degrade performance. The shock-focused XPINN achieves the lowest overall solution errors, indicating that increased local network capacity can provide greater benefit than increasing overlap alone. RAR produces the largest improvements during early refinement stages, followed by increasingly non-monotonic changes in accuracy. These findings highlight the importance of jointly considering decomposition, interface coupling, network capacity, and adaptive refinement for shock-dominated problems.

AI.tldr: 系统评估XPINN的域分解设计（重叠宽度、冲击区局部网络容量）对一维粘性Burgers方程激波解的精度影响。
AI.motivation: PINN难以处理陡梯度与激波主导解，XPINN通过域分解缓解该问题，但分解设计、重叠与局部网络容量对精度的影响尚未充分刻画。
AI.method: 针对一维粘性Burgers方程(ν=0.01/π)，对比标准PINN、常规XPINN、在含激波子域增容的冲击聚焦XPINN，以及不同重叠宽度的XPINN；统一采用Adam、L-BFGS精调与10次RAR循环训练，并用全局/激波区相对L2与L∞误差、最大PDE残差及界面连续性误差评估。
AI.result: 分解设计显著影响精度与激波分辨率；重叠配置中最小重叠最优，较大重叠反而劣化；冲击聚焦XPINN整体误差最低，说明提升局部网络容量比单纯增大重叠更有效；RAR在早期迭代收益最大，后期改进呈非单调。
AI.conclusion: 激波主导问题需协同考虑域分解、界面耦合、网络容量与自适应细化。

title: Energy-Stable Parametric Operator Inference across Regime Transitions: Application to Unconfined Buoyant Plumes in Stratified Ambients
summary: Buoyant plumes in stratified ambients arise in wildfire smoke transport, ventilation, and pollutant dispersion, where many-query prediction requires models that stay accurate and stable as the dynamics transition from free rise to internal-wave trapping. Operator Inference (OpInf) learns polynomial reduced models from snapshots, and the Boussinesq plume depends affinely on the squared buoyancy frequency $N^2$. However, this compatibility masks two stability gaps: a single affine operator family can distort the per-parameter dynamics into unstable spectra, and for quadratic OpInf models, finite-time blowup is governed by a cubic energy injection channel from the inferred quadratic operator. To address these gaps, we develop cyclic-skew regime-bridged OpInf (CR-OpInf). We derive an affine-inadequacy diagnostic that links the departure from a shared affine family to destabilizing spectral drift before integration. In place of the shared affine fit, we interpolate per-parameter operators with a Gaussian kernel. We also extend the cyclic-skew quadratic constraint to the buoyancy-source-forced parametric setting, closing the cubic energy channel and isolating this closure as the boundedness mechanism. We further introduce a regime-bridging basis split that resolves free rise and trapped intrusion structures while preserving the cyclic-skew structure under convex interpolation. Applied to an unconfined Boussinesq plume and a viscous Burgers problem spanning a smooth-to-shock transition, CR-OpInf remains bounded for five training horizons, avoids the divergence of affine and unconstrained variants, tracks the plume rise, and recovers stratification-dependent rise scaling at moderate horizons. To our knowledge, this is the first parametric OpInf study of an unconfined stratified plume.

AI.tldr: 针对分层环境浮力羽流的参数化降阶问题，提出循环斜对称−按参数间插值−工况桥接的 OpInf（CR-OpInf），在不更新参数族共享仿射拟合的前提下保证数值有界与谱稳定。
AI.motivation: 浮力羽流（野火烟、通风、污染物扩散）需多次查询预测，且动力学从自由上升过渡到内波捕获。Boussinesq 羽流对 N² 仿射依赖看似适配 OpInf，但共享仿射算子族可能歪曲各参数动力学导致谱失稳；二次 OpInf 还存在由推断二次算子引起的三次能量注入通道导致有限时间爆破。
AI.method: 1) 提出仿射不充分性诊断，积分前量化"偏离共享仿射族"与失稳谱漂移的关系；2) 改为用高斯核对逐参数算子插值；3) 将循环斜对称二次约束推广到含浮力源强迫的参数化设定，封闭三次能量通道；4) 引入工况桥接基分裂，分别分辨自由上升与捕获侵入结构，并在凸插值下保持循环斜对称结构。
AI.result: 在无约束 Boussinesq 羽流与跨光滑-激波过渡的粘性 Burgers 问题上，CR-OpInf 在 5 个训练时长内保持有界，避免了仿射与无约束变体的发散，能跟踪羽流上升，并在中等时长恢复随分层变化的上升标度律。
AI.conclusion: 首次对无约束分层羽流开展参数化 OpInf 研究；诊断+核插值+循环斜对称约束+工况桥接基的组合实现了稳定、有界且物理一致的参数化降阶建模。

title: BBun: an unsteady vortex-ring panel method for interacting lifting bodies, box wings and propellers
summary: This report documents BBun (Blunt Body unsteady), a low-order code for the unsteady potential flow around one or more interacting three-dimensional bodies. The bodies are represented by vortex rings (piecewise-constant doublets) with a Neumann boundary condition; free vortex sheets are shed from the trailing edges and, optionally, from the tips, and convected in time, with an implicit unsteady Kutta condition. The report describes the choices that make the discretization consistent and convergent (a single desingularized kernel per wake line, a bordered factorization of the singular Neumann problem, interior velocity conditions for the nearly singular mode of ring-shaped bodies, the detection of the separation lines from the grid connectivity) and the extensions to several bodies, box wings, symmetric configurations (image method), non-lifting bodies, rigidly rotating bodies (propellers), the unsteady Bernoulli equation, a wake-body collision treatment and a strip-wise integral boundary layer. The verification and validation are reported in full: potential flow around a sphere, sensitivity and grid convergence, the two-dimensional limit, an independent vortex-lattice method, the NACA 0015 wing of McAlister and Takahashi (loads and chordwise pressures), the NACA 0012 profile drag, the biplane of Knight and Noyes, Prandtl's best wing system, Wagner's function and blade-element momentum theory for a propeller. A complete aircraft with counter-rotating tractor propellers illustrates the use of the code.

AI.tldr: BBun 是一个用于多体相互干扰三维非定常势流的低阶面元代码，报告系统给出了保证离散一致收敛的数值选择、多项功能扩展，以及对球体、翼型、双翼机、螺旋桨等大量算例的验证。
AI.motivation: 需要一个能处理多个相互作用三维体、尾涡自由脱落与对流、带非定常 Kutta 条件的低阶非定常势流工具，并解决近奇异核、奇异 Neumann 问题、分离线识别等导致离散不一致或不收敛的数值难点。
AI.method: 体表面用涡环（分片常数偶极子）表示并施加 Neumann 边界条件；自由涡面从后缘（可选翼尖）脱落并随时间对流，采用隐式非定常 Kutta 条件；关键数值处理包括每条尾涡线单一去奇异核、奇异 Neumann 问题的加边分解、环形体近奇异模态的内部速度条件、由网格连通性检测分离线；扩展至多体、盒式翼、对称构型（镜像法）、非升力体、刚性旋转体（螺旋桨）、非定常 Bernoulli 方程、涡-体碰撞处理和展向条带积分边界层。
AI.result: 验证与确认完整：球体势流、敏感性与网格收敛、二维极限、独立涡格法对比、McAlister & Takahashi 的 NACA 0015（载荷与弦向压力）、NACA 0012 剖面阻力、Knight & Noyes 双翼机、Prandtl 最佳翼系统、Wagner 函数及螺旋桨叶片元动量理论；并以带对转牵引螺旋桨的完整飞机演示了代码使用。
AI.conclusion: BBun 通过上述数值选择实现了一致且收敛的离散，具备多体、旋转体、边界层耦合等实用扩展，并在广泛的经典算例中获得了良好验证，可用于考虑螺旋桨干扰的完整飞机非定常气动分析。

title: Thermochemically Constrained Multiscale Laplace Neural Operator to Learn Stiff Chemical Kinetics with Conditional Diffusion Model Sampling
comment: Main text: 14 pages, 13 figures. Supplementary Materials: 3 pages, 3 figures
summary: Stiff chemical kinetics is a major computational bottleneck in reacting-flow simulations, while data-driven solvers remain sensitive to training-state coverage and chemical dynamics. This work combines conditional diffusion sampling with a thermochemically constrained multiscale Laplace neural operator (TC-MLNO) for chemistry ODE integration. The diffusion model learns the equivalence-ratio-conditioned joint distribution of temperature and species from low-dimensional flame data, augmenting the state space without independent perturbations. TC-MLNO represents transient, non-periodic responses through pole-residue Laplace layers and assigns fast, medium, and slow species to separate branches. Thermochemical constraints are imposed through losses for mass and elemental conservation and heat release rate. The framework is evaluated in 1D premixed flames, a 2D developing jet, and a 3D turbulent burner flame. With equal-sized datasets, diffusion sampling reduces the 95th-percentile distance to the base flame manifold by up to 37.5% and the a posteriori full-species macro-average error by up to 92.7% versus random sampling, especially for minor species and radicals. TC-LNO yields smaller errors than the DeepONet baseline for 84.9% of retained modes and reduces the 95th-percentile error for the most attenuated modes from 0.372 to 0.081. In multidimensional flames, TC-MLNO better preserves reaction-zone locations, heat-release structures, and chemically sensitive species than DeepONet. Errors of representative radical and nitrogen-containing species in the 3D flame decrease by 88.0%-88.9%. Compared with direct CVODE integration, TC-MLNO reduces mean chemistry and total solution times by 90.1% and 62.6%, respectively. These results show that distribution-aware sampling and Laplace neural operator learning provide an accurate and efficient alternative for stiff chemical ODE integration.

AI.tldr: 该工作将条件扩散采样与热化学约束的多尺度拉普拉斯神经算子（TC-MLNO）结合用于化学ODE积分，在多维火焰中实现高精度且大幅加速的刚性化学动力学求解。
AI.motivation: 刚性化学动力学是反应流模拟的主要计算瓶颈，而数据驱动求解器对训练状态覆盖和化学动力学变化敏感，易导致误差大、覆盖不足。
AI.method: 用条件扩散模型从低维火焰数据学习以当量比为条件的温度-组分联合分布，以增强状态空间（无需独立扰动）；TC-MLNO通过极点-留数拉普拉斯层表征瞬态非周期响应，并将快、中、慢组分分配到不同分支；同时以质量和元素守恒、放热率损失引入热化学约束。
AI.result: 在1D预混火焰、2D发展射流和3D湍流燃烧器火焰中评估：同等数据量下，扩散采样较随机采样将到基础火焰流形的95百分位距离最多降低37.5%，后验全组分宏平均误差最多降低92.7%；TC-LNO在84.9%的保留模态上误差小于DeepONet，最衰减模态95百分位误差由0.372降至0.081；3D火焰中代表性自由基和含氮组分误差降低88.0%–88.9%；相较CVODE，化学与总求解时间分别减少90.1%和62.6%。
AI.conclusion: 分布感知采样与拉普拉斯神经算子学习为刚性化学ODE积分提供了准确、高效的替代方案。

title: Global-in-time Spectral Duhamel-Picard Method for Post-Exposure Bake Simulation and Physics-Informed Neural Operators for EUV Lithography
summary: We present a global-in-time spectral Duhamel-Picard method with polynomial expansions for post-exposure bake (PEB) simulation. The coupled acid-quencher reaction-diffusion equations are reformulated as nonlinear Volterra integral equations using the Duhamel principle. Full trajectories are represented by finite polynomial expansions, with temporal coefficient fields determined over the bake interval by Anderson-accelerated Picard iteration, thereby avoiding sequential time marching. In 3-D PEB simulations, we employ Chebyshev and Legendre temporal bases while evaluating the Duhamel integrals using the corresponding Gaussian quadrature rules. We demonstrate that the proposed method simulates a large domain of $1200\times1200\times100$ voxels on the order of one minute. The representation is further incorporated into a physics-informed neural operator (PINO) with a mixed-transform variant of a factorized Fourier neural operator, which is trained without precomputed solution trajectories. Together, the integral formulation and its PINO extension enable accelerated, time-marching-free prediction of concentration fields at arbitrary times within the bake interval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出全局时间谱Duhamel-Picard方法求解PEB中的酸-淬灭剂反应扩散方程，避免逐步时间推进，并结合PINO实现任意时刻浓度场快速预测。
AI.motivation: 传统PEB仿真需顺序时间推进，3-D大尺度计算代价高，难以在烘焙区间内任意时刻快速获得浓度场。
AI.method: 利用Duhamel原理将耦合酸-淬灭剂反应扩散方程重写为非线性Volterra积分方程；用有限多项式展开（Chebyshev/Legendre时间基，配对应Gauss求积）表示整条轨迹，通过Anderson加速的Picard迭代求解时间系数场；进一步将该表示嵌入带混合变换的因式化Fourier神经算子PINO，无需预计算解轨迹即可训练。
AI.result: 3-D PEB仿真可在约一分钟量级处理1200×1200×100体素的大区域；PINO扩展可对烘焙区间内任意时刻浓度场实现免时间推进的加速预测。
AI.conclusion: 积分表述与PINO结合能实现高效、无时间步进的PEB浓度场预测，兼具大尺度仿真能力与算子学习的泛化加速优势。

title: An implicit multiscale solver for steady kinetic equations based on wave-particle decomposition
comment: 63 pages, including 44 pages of main text and 19 pages of supplementary material
summary: Steady kinetic computations require accurate transport on meshes that do not resolve the mean free path and efficient removal of slowly decaying macroscopic errors. We develop a closed wave-particle decomposition (WPD) and a residual-based implicit solver for this problem. The wave accumulates only the Maxwellian along a local characteristic horizon and is determined by the conservative variables; the particle carries the kinetic complement and collision remainder. Under moment compatibility, the closed system is equivalent to the kinetic equation. For the Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook and Shakhov models, a hydrodynamic expansion gives the wave and particle contributions to the Euler and Navier-Stokes fluxes. The implicit iteration couples macroscopic prediction to microscopic correction through a discrete endpoint term and synchronizes the conservative moments after each accepted correction. Its stationary states satisfy the target discrete kinetic equation independently of the iteration controls. Formal analysis gives the smooth fixed-mesh fluid limit. Linear model analysis relates convergence to the horizon-to-relaxation ratio, incomplete macroscopic solves and explicit collision remainders. One- and two-dimensional computations of a normal shock, internal flows and hypersonic external flows test these properties across rarefied and continuum regimes. The results show kinetic fidelity and substantial reductions in iteration counts and wall time relative to the conventional iterative scheme near the continuum limit. Collision-model comparisons and parameter studies support the predicted convergence mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出闭合的波粒分解(WPD)与基于残差的隐式求解器，用于在网格不分辨平均自由程时实现稳定、高效的动理学计算。
AI.motivation: 稳态动理学计算需要两类能力：在未解析平均自由程的网格上保持输运精度，以及高效消除衰减缓慢的宏观误差。传统迭代格式在近连续极限下收敛极慢。
AI.method: 构造闭合WPD：波只沿局部特征地平线累积Maxwellian并由守恒变量确定，粒子携带动理学补量与碰撞余项，在矩相容条件下与动理学方程等价。对BGK与Shakhov模型作流体力学展开，给出波/粒子对Euler与Navier–Stokes通量的贡献；提出以离散端点项耦合宏观预测与微观修正、每次接受修正后同步守恒矩的隐式迭代，其稳态与迭代控制无关。并进行光滑固定网格流体极限的形式分析及线性模型收敛分析。
AI.result: 线性分析将收敛性与地平线-弛豫比、宏观求解不完全及显式碰撞余项联系起来。一维/二维正激波、内流与高超声速外流的稀薄至连续区算例显示保持动理学保真度，近连续极限下迭代数与墙钟时间较常规迭代方案显著降低；碰撞模型对比与参数研究验证了预测的收敛机制。
AI.conclusion: WPD加残差隐式迭代在未解析网格上兼顾动理学精度与近连续区的高效收敛，是一类稳健的稳态动理学求解框架。

title: A differentiable PCA-GPR surrogate framework for full-transient Bayesian inverse uncertainty quantification of black-box nuclear thermal-hydraulic systems
summary: Complex transient energy systems require uncertainty-quantified predictions, but Bayesian inverse uncertainty quantification (IUQ) is often impractical because posterior sampling with high-fidelity system codes requires many expensive full-transient simulations. This study develops a surrogate-assisted Bayesian IUQ framework that makes full-time-series calibration practical for the NACIE heavy-liquid-metal natural-circulation loop. The key innovation is to transform a black-box transient simulator into a differentiable probabilistic emulator by combining principal component analysis with Gaussian process regression (PCA--GPR). The surrogate reconstructs complete multichannel temperature and mass-flow histories from a compact latent representation, preserving dominant temporal and cross-channel correlations while enabling automatic differentiation of the log posterior. This allows both gradient-free ensemble slice sampling and gradient-informed sampling with the No-U-Turn Sampler and Microcanonical Langevin Monte Carlo. Five principal components capture more than 99\% of the output variance, and the surrogate achieves normalized root-mean-square errors below 2\%. Compared with direct Flownex SE evaluations, the surrogate reduces likelihood-evaluation cost by approximately 3000-fold while preserving posterior statistics and correlations. Posterior predictive analyses show reduced bias, narrower intervals, and improved agreement with measurements and independent validation.

AI.tldr: 提出代理辅助的贝叶斯逆不确定性量化框架，将黑箱瞬态仿真器转化为可微概率代理，实现NACIE自然循环回路的全时序校准，似然评估成本降低约3000倍。
AI.motivation: 复杂瞬态能源系统需要带不确定性量化的预测，但高保真系统代码下贝叶斯后验采样需大量昂贵的全瞬态仿真，使IUQ在实践中难以实施。
AI.method: 结合主成分分析（PCA）与高斯过程回归（GPR），把黑箱瞬态仿真器转为可微概率代理；代理从紧凑潜变量重构多通道温度与质量流量全时序，保留主要时空与跨通道相关性，并支持对数后验的自动微分；随后采用无梯度集合切片采样及梯度引导的NUTS与微正则朗之万蒙特卡洛采样。
AI.result: 5个主成分捕获超99%输出方差，代理NRMSE低于2%；相比直接Flownex SE评估，似然评估成本降约3000倍且保持后验统计与相关性；后验预测偏差减小、区间更窄，与测量及独立验证吻合更好。
AI.conclusion: PCA-GPR可微代理使全时序贝叶斯IUQ在复杂瞬态系统上可行，在显著降本的同时保持甚至改善后验质量，为昂贵仿真代码的不确定性量化提供实用路径。

title: A Scalable Sharp-Interface Immersed Boundary Method for Moving Boundary Flow Simulation on Multi-GPU Systems
summary: Sharp-interface immersed boundary methods provide a versatile framework for simulating flows with complex moving boundaries, but their irregular data structures, dynamic sparsity, and discontinuous pressure operators present significant challenges for efficient multi-GPU implementation. This work presents a fully GPU-native, multi-GPU acceleration of the sharp-interface immersed boundary solver, ViCar3D. The implementation combines a hybrid OpenACC/CUDA programming model with a matrix decomposition that isolates dynamically changing immersed-boundary operators, GPU-optimized geometric kernels, asynchronous dual-stream sparse matrix--vector execution, and a symmetric-memory-based sparse communication strategy. A GPU-oriented iterative solver employing a preconditioned stabilized bi-conjugate gradient (BiCGStab) method is developed to efficiently treat the pressure Poisson equation on highly stretched Cartesian grids. The resulting framework preserves the accuracy and versatility of the original solver while delivering substantial acceleration and scalability for simulations involving complex moving and deforming immersed boundaries, thereby extending the applicability of sharp-interface immersed boundary methods to extreme-scale computational fluid dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文实现了一个全GPU原生、多GPU加速的锐界面浸没边界求解器ViCar3D，通过混合OpenACC/CUDA模型、矩阵分解、GPU优化几何核、双流异步SpMV及对称内存通信策略，显著提升了复杂运动边界流动的模拟效率与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 锐界面浸没边界法虽能灵活模拟复杂运动边界，但其不规则数据结构、动态稀疏性和不连续压力算子给高效多GPU实现带来巨大挑战，限制了其在极端规模CFD中的应用。
AI.method: 提出全GPU原生多GPU加速实现：采用混合OpenACC/CUDA编程模型，利用矩阵分解隔离动态变化的浸没边界算子，设计GPU优化的几何核函数，实现异步双流SpMV稀疏矩阵向量乘法，并采用基于对称内存的稀疏通信策略；同时开发GPU导向的预处理BiCGStab迭代求解器以高效处理高度拉伸笛卡尔网格上的压力泊松方程。
AI.result: 该框架在保持原求解器精度与通用性的同时，为涉及复杂运动与变形浸没边界的模拟提供了显著的加速效果和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓展了锐界面浸没边界方法在极端规模计算流体力学中的适用性，验证了GPU原生多GPU实现在此类复杂流动模拟中的有效性。

title: RAT-EC: Introducing a New Open-Source 3D Volume-Integral Eddy-Current Module
comment: 16 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Magnetics. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. Code: https://gitlab.com/Project-Rat ; reproducibility repository: https://gitlab.cern.ch/steam/analyses/rat-ec_validation_and_verification
summary: We present RAT-EC, an open-source volume-integral eddy-current module for unstructured meshes, driven in the time domain by coils of arbitrary winding geometry. It is the first openly available code of this kind and part of the open-source RAT suite. Because only the conductor is meshed, neither the surrounding air nor an artificial outer boundary has to be modelled, which simplifies model preparation and brings problems with thin gaps and intricate air regions within reach of standard hardware. The formulation combines a semi-analytical evaluation of the singular and near-singular inductance terms, a multi-level fast multipole method that accelerates both the far-field inductance action and the coil field, topology-aware constraints for multiply connected conductors, and a matrix-free, GPU-accelerated time integration. The implementation is verified against closed-form solutions for a conducting sphere and a conducting ring, and is validated on the TEAM-7 benchmark. At 50 Hz, RAT-EC reproduces the measured field as accurately as finite-element solutions. At 200 Hz, it agrees with a converged finite-element model, but both deviate from published measurements, which suggests that this benchmark point should be re-examined. RAT-EC provides an open platform for volume-integral eddy-current simulation and method development.

AI.tldr: RAT-EC：首个开源的体积分涡流仿真模块，支持非结构网格与时域任意线圈驱动，仅需剖分导体本身。
AI.motivation: 体积分涡流方法以往缺乏公开可用的代码实现；且该方法只需剖分导体、无需建空气域和外边界，可简化建模并让薄间隙、复杂空气区问题在普通硬件上可解。
AI.method: 结合奇异与近奇异电感项的半解析计算、同时加速远场电感作用与线圈场的多层快速多极子方法、针对多连通导体的拓扑感知约束，以及无矩阵的GPU加速时间积分。
AI.result: 对导体球与导体环的解析解完成验证，并在TEAM-7基准上完成确认；50 Hz下精度与有限元相当并吻合实测，200 Hz下与收敛有限元一致但二者均偏离已发表测量，提示该基准点需重新审视。
AI.conclusion: RAT-EC为体积分涡流仿真及方法发展提供了开放平台。
